00d5a6afb424.en: Harry dances with July (or rather, she teaches him how)
00d5a6afb424.t: Harry menari dengan July (atau lebih tepat, July mengajarnya)

0506c85e3131.en: Something soft and warm falls against his arm: Magi has fallen asleep. Harry looks at her cuteness, then notices her weapon and backpack. He asks if she's okay, but she doesn't respond. He shifts to make her more comfortable, and she suddenly wakes up.
0506c85e3131.t: Sesuatu yang lembut dan hangat jatuh ke lengannya: Magi tertidur. Harry memandang kecomelannya, kemudian perasan senjata dan beg galasnya. Dia bertanya sama ada dia okey, tetapi dia tidak menjawab. Harry beralih untuk menjadikannya lebih selesa, dan dia tiba-tiba terjaga.

06ec9f6b1a65.en: Dalila, quietly eating, looks at Harry, then back at her food, taking another bite of the tender, juicy, slightly gamy Bagarisa. She starts staring intently at Harry's plate. "I can eat it for you." Nailah: "Desmond, can you give your Bagarisa to Dalila? I don't want to see food wasted."
06ec9f6b1a65.t: Dalila, makan dengan senyap, memandang Harry, kemudian kembali kepada makanannya, menggigit lagi Bagarisa yang lembut, berair dan sedikit hamis. Dia mula merenung pinggan Harry dengan tajam. “Aku boleh makankan untuk kau.” Nailah: “Desmond, boleh bagi Bagarisa kau kepada Dalila? Aku tak nak tengok makanan membazir.”

0738030a5363.en: Nailah looks at her husband. "I think she'd have a better time somewhere without so many memories." Severino: "I was talking with Desmond earlier today. Maybe next time Yosuke stops by, we can see if he needs an assistant?" Dalila looks at them, Bagarisa juice on her chin, mouth full. "Who's that?" "The chef of The Wood People Picker."
0738030a5363.t: Nailah memandang suaminya. “Aku rasa dia akan lebih seronok di tempat yang tak begitu banyak kenangan.” Severino: “Aku bercakap dengan Desmond tadi. Mungkin lain kali Yosuke singgah, kita boleh tengok kalau dia perlukan pembantu?” Dalila memandang mereka, jus Bagarisa di dagunya, mulut penuh. “Siapa tu?” “Chef The Wood People Picker.”

0803a92fd9e6.en: As they dance, she asks lots of personal questions. Harry evades anything about Sanbi and Eori; she notices how he deflects his past, lets it go, and stops pushing.
0803a92fd9e6.t: Sambil menari, dia bertanya banyak soalan peribadi. Harry mengelak apa-apa tentang Sanbi dan Eori; dia perasan bagaimana Harry mengalihkan cerita tentang masa lalunya, membiarkannya, dan berhenti mendesak.

0887c32d0f25.en: Harry needs to change his appearance, yet nobody seems to have noticed him so far. His beard makes him look different, so he marches on just fine.
0887c32d0f25.t: Harry perlu menukar rupanya, namun setakat ini tiada siapa nampaknya perasan dia. Janggutnya membuatnya nampak lain, jadi dia terus melangkah tanpa masalah.

0a20c05ba0a7.en: Harry #13 has breakfast outside with Takeo and a few others; Takeo's wagon nearby holds three bodies and the Bagarisa, all frozen in ice
0a20c05ba0a7.t: Harry #13 bersarapan di luar bersama Takeo dan beberapa orang lain; gerabak Takeo berdekatan memuatkan tiga mayat dan Bagarisa itu, semuanya beku dalam ais

0a26181ee767.en: The Halfway Inn: Kibe and Eori

0a6938481a23.en: Coema is pissed that they've both grown too soft and became pawns in Neferteri's hands, doing things against their will; now she regrets retiring from the position. She looks at them. "Payback is a bitch! You need to teach her a lesson!" Eiri: "I can't do that! She's the Queen of Sanbi!" "And you're the King's maid!" It finally clicks for Eiri that she does have power.
0a6938481a23.t: Coema bengang kerana kedua-dua mereka sudah terlalu lembut dan menjadi bidak di tangan Neferteri, melakukan perkara di luar kehendak mereka; sekarang dia menyesal bersara daripada jawatan itu. Dia memandang mereka. “Balasan memang celaka! Kau kena ajar dia!” Eiri: “Aku tak boleh buat macam tu! Dia Permaisuri Sanbi!” “Dan kau King-maid!” Akhirnya Eiri sedar dia memang ada kuasa.

0b33aba93f1c.en: Harry is happy they care about him so much. He forgets the horrors he committed.
0b33aba93f1c.t: Harry gembira mereka begitu mengambil berat tentangnya. Dia lupa kengerian yang telah dilakukannya.

0bbc63c0d24f.en: {WIP-katsumiBandit}: "Why? Who are you?" "What are you talking about?" "I said, who the fuck are you?" {WIP-blackMaginaGuy} grabs him by the shoulders. "You don't remember? Magina guy? I'm {WIP-blackMaginaGuy}! I've known you for, like, twenty years!"
0bbc63c0d24f.t: {WIP-katsumiBandit}: “Kenapa? Siapa kau?” “Apa kau merepek ni?” “Aku kata, siapa celaka kau ni?” {WIP-blackMaginaGuy} mencekak bahunya. “Kau tak ingat? Lelaki Magina? Aku {WIP-blackMaginaGuy}! Aku dah kenal kau, macam, dua puluh tahun!”

0c42c44ed2af.en: Eori, bored at dinner; her roommate asks what she wants to do, and Eori says nothing, since she wants to research more
0c42c44ed2af.t: Eori, bosan semasa makan malam; rakan sebiliknya bertanya apa yang dia mahu buat, dan Eori tidak berkata apa-apa, kerana dia mahu menyelidik lebih lagi

0da86e9b0ecb.en: The two Saynas look at each other. The quiet one, Katsuki, turns and walks away from her sister. Katsumi, the rebel, grows sad as she lies there, searching for the words, but when she tries to speak, only cutesy noises come out. The quiet Sayna glances at her and keeps walking.
0da86e9b0ecb.t: Dua ekor Sayna itu saling berpandangan. Yang pendiam, Katsuki, berpaling dan berjalan menjauhi kakaknya. Katsumi, si pemberontak, menjadi sedih ketika berbaring di situ, mencari perkataan, tetapi apabila dia cuba bercakap, hanya bunyi comel yang keluar. Sayna yang pendiam itu mengerlingnya dan terus berjalan.

0daa26198a65.en: Dalila's eyes well up and she hugs the father and mother. "Thank you!" Harry, a bit embarrassed, hugs them too, while Dalila hugs Vitor and lifts him off the ground. Vitor looks out of breath; Harry kneels to his level, and they slap hands, then bump fists.
0daa26198a65.t: Mata Dalila bergenang dan dia memeluk si bapa dan si ibu. “Terima kasih!” Harry, sedikit malu, memeluk mereka juga, sementara Dalila memeluk Vitor dan mengangkatnya dari tanah. Vitor nampak sesak nafas; Harry melutut ke parasnya, dan mereka berlaga tapak tangan, kemudian berlaga penumbuk.

0f0da724d2b8.en: Sora talks with the other maids in the kitchen
0f0da724d2b8.t: Sora bercakap dengan pembantu rumah lain di dapur

110ca8bfc9c0.en: He looks at Dalila again, with no idea what to talk about. "Hmm. What's your favorite food?" "Bagarisa." Harry nods, breathing out through his nose. "Makes sense." I guess she'd never be friends with them after all that— Images of the playful Bagarisas come to mind. I wish I could have killed the bandits and revived them instead. If only I was stronger. He interlocks his fingers, tightening the grip. If only.
110ca8bfc9c0.t: Dia memandang Dalila lagi, tidak tahu apa nak dibualkan. “Hmm. Apa makanan kegemaran kau?” “Bagarisa.” Harry mengangguk, menghembus nafas melalui hidung. “Masuk akal.” Rasanya dia takkan berkawan dengan mereka selepas semua tu— Bayangan Bagarisa yang suka bermain terlintas di fikiran. Aku harap aku boleh bunuh penyamun-penyamun tu dan hidupkan mereka semula. Kalaulah aku lebih kuat. Dia menyilangkan jari-jarinya, mengetatkan genggaman. Kalaulah.

116b7af835b2.en: Harry #13 sits by Dalila while everyone eats out in the open; three bandits hang upside down
116b7af835b2.t: Harry #13 duduk di sebelah Dalila sementara semua orang makan di kawasan lapang; tiga penyamun tergantung terbalik

12eb007cc2a4.en: Neferteri: "Oh, dear daughter, I knew you would accomplish this wonderful goal." Eori doesn't look happy. "From here we're heading to Forway, where you shall focus on your studies and clear your mind of past events." Eori looks even less happy.
12eb007cc2a4.t: Neferteri: “Oh, anakanda tersayang, bonda tahu anakanda akan mencapai matlamat yang hebat ini.” Eori tidak nampak gembira. “Dari sini kita menuju ke Forway, tempat anakanda akan menumpukan pada pengajian dan membersihkan fikiran daripada peristiwa lalu.” Eori nampak lebih tidak gembira.

12f7fd371940.en: The fight ends with Katsumi protecting Katsuki. Katsuki cries as a Sayna, and Katsumi shields her and holds her close. (Sorenos are in Fauna.)
12f7fd371940.t: Pertarungan berakhir dengan Katsumi melindungi Katsuki. Katsuki menangis sebagai Sayna, dan Katsumi melindunginya dan memeluknya erat. (Sorenos ada dalam Fauna.)

152e8fffddaf.en: Hanako comes over. "You got back pretty late yesterday and didn't say much. What happened?" Mimi sits on Harry's other side, mimicking Hanako. Desmond looks down. "She asked how much it was." Hanako bursts out laughing. "Is that why? I thought you got dumped or something." "Well, that too." "So, how much did she give you?" "Nothing. We called it an impromptu date."
152e8fffddaf.t: Hanako datang. “Kau balik agak lewat semalam dan tak banyak cakap. Apa jadi?” Mimi duduk di sebelah Harry yang lagi satu, meniru Hanako. Desmond menunduk. “Dia tanya berapa harganya.” Hanako ketawa terbahak-bahak. “Sebab tu ke? Aku ingat kau kena tinggal ke apa.” “Yalah, itu pun.” “Jadi, berapa dia bagi kau?” “Tak ada. Kami panggil ia temu janji mengejut.”

15e4fa1ba6e2.en: Katsumi: "Egua Races! That was awesome! The Eguas were running so fast!" Ryo: "Wait until you see a Dueling Egua Race! Nari gels are allowed on both the rider and the Egua!" "Let's go see it!" "Hold your Eguas." He laughs like a dad. "That competition won't start until the current one finishes. Anything else you two want to do?"
15e4fa1ba6e2.t: Katsumi: “Egua Races! Hebat gila! Egua lari laju sangat!” Ryo: “Tunggu sampai kau tengok Dueling Egua Race! Nari gel dibenarkan pada penunggang dan Egua!” “Jom pergi tengok!” “Sabar dulu.” Dia ketawa macam seorang ayah. “Pertandingan tu takkan bermula sampai yang sekarang habis. Ada apa-apa lagi korang nak buat?”

177ccc8f12bb.en: His mind clicks back to reality. He hears a commotion, and looking back, sees a crowd forming. "Eh. They're probably playing Stealball."
177ccc8f12bb.t: Fikirannya kembali ke realiti. Dia mendengar kekecohan, dan menoleh, nampak orang ramai berkumpul. “Eh. Mungkin mereka main Stealball.”

184d466e701a.en: Severino: "Hey, Vitor, can you take Dalila to her bed?" Vitor does, and Harry sees the defeated look on Dalila as she's carried away. Severino says Harry will sleep in the barn over there with the others, since nobody knows who's who yet. Harry nods.
184d466e701a.t: Severino: “Hei, Vitor, boleh bawa Dalila ke katilnya?” Vitor berbuat begitu, dan Harry nampak wajah kalah Dalila ketika dia dibawa pergi. Severino kata Harry akan tidur di bangsal di sana bersama yang lain, kerana belum ada siapa tahu siapa sebenarnya siapa. Harry mengangguk.

18c436416281.en: Magi stares him in the eyes, then turns her head away without a word, scoots closer to the person on her other side, clutches her backpack tighter, and ends up falling asleep bent forward. (Magi has narcolepsy, and she's rather distrustful of people.) Harry feels unwanted. Then he notices her clothes are tattered. Is she an adventurer? Her clothes look pretty worn for an adventurer.
18c436416281.t: Magi merenung matanya, kemudian memalingkan kepala tanpa sepatah kata, mengengsot lebih dekat kepada orang di sebelahnya yang lagi satu, memeluk beg galasnya lebih erat, dan akhirnya tertidur membongkok ke depan. (Magi menghidap narkolepsi, dan dia agak tidak mempercayai orang.) Harry rasa tidak diingini. Kemudian dia perasan pakaiannya compang-camping. Dia pengembara ke? Pakaian dia nampak agak lusuh untuk pengembara.

18ec863cea7f.en: Harry drops off two beers. "Anything else I can help with?" Maicon waves him off. Ryo: "Desmond, right?" "Yes, sir." "Can you thank the chef for me?" "Will certainly do, sir." Harry nods and leaves.
18ec863cea7f.t: Harry menghantar dua bir. “Ada apa-apa lagi saya boleh bantu?” Maicon mengibas tangan menyuruhnya pergi. Ryo: “Desmond, kan?” “Ya, tuan.” “Boleh tolong sampaikan terima kasih aku kepada chef?” “Pasti, tuan.” Harry mengangguk dan beredar.

1a34b2a184dc.en: Takeo mentions he's leaving for Forway, and tells Desmond he really wanted him to try escaping yesterday. Harry: "I'm no bandit."
1a34b2a184dc.t: Takeo menyebut dia akan bertolak ke Forway, dan memberitahu Desmond dia betul-betul mahu Desmond cuba lari semalam. Harry: “Aku bukan penyamun.”

1af40ad1fd2c.en: Severino: "You two will catch the next wagon to Forway's South Entrance. Once you get there, ask for the restaurant. Make sure not to spend it all: you only have about 10 Pearls to spare."
1af40ad1fd2c.t: Severino: “Korang berdua akan naik gerabak seterusnya ke Pintu Masuk Selatan Forway. Bila sampai, tanya pasal restoran tu. Pastikan jangan habiskan semuanya: korang cuma ada lebih kurang 10 Pearl untuk dibelanjakan.”

1b3663a91979.en: A tug on her paddle: Kibe has used a hook on a long rod to attach his boat to hers, and he brings her into the city docks. Eori is thankful, but her moral fiber rejects the help. With a firm refusal, she heads for the endless-looking stairs.
1b3663a91979.t: Satu tarikan pada pendayungnya: Kibe telah menggunakan cangkuk pada batang panjang untuk menyambung botnya pada bot Eori, dan dia membawanya ke dermaga bandar. Eori bersyukur, tetapi prinsip moralnya menolak bantuan itu. Dengan penolakan yang tegas, dia menuju ke tangga yang nampak tiada penghujung.

1be831e48243.en: Takeo talks with the Forway captain, who chews on a Steen stick with his feet up, guards around them
1be831e48243.t: Takeo bercakap dengan kapten Forway, yang mengunyah batang Steen dengan kaki terangkat, pengawal di sekeliling mereka

1c6348ff337e.en: A crowd swarms the docks to watch Eori push a kayak into the water by herself; Kibe follows. Eori's will is iron. (It starts as swimming, but Eori uses her wits, and pity, to manipulate her way into a paddle boat.)
1c6348ff337e.t: Orang ramai membanjiri dermaga untuk melihat Eori menolak sebuah kayak ke dalam air seorang diri; Kibe mengikut. Tekad Eori sekeras besi. (Ia bermula dengan berenang, tetapi Eori menggunakan akalnya, dan simpati orang, untuk memanipulasi dirinya ke dalam sebuah bot dayung.)

1eceacc77d6b.en: Harry #12, half asleep on his side, wakes up while two others (weak and feeble on purpose) talk behind him
1eceacc77d6b.t: Harry #12, separuh tidur mengiring, terjaga ketika dua orang lain (lemah dan longlai dengan sengaja) bercakap di belakangnya

2098054638d0.en: Dalila stops eating and walking, and her face falls. She puts the chip back in the bag. "Pappa taught me everything, including the shortcuts." Harry doesn't know what to say, and forces a smile. "They seem like nice people."
2098054638d0.t: Dalila berhenti makan dan berjalan, dan wajahnya muram. Dia meletakkan kerepek itu semula ke dalam beg. “Pappa ajar aku semuanya, termasuk jalan pintas.” Harry tidak tahu apa nak cakap, dan memaksa senyuman. “Mereka nampak macam orang baik.”

214b0cc35c90.en: Among the crowd, Sora spots Coema and takes off running ahead of Eiri to hug her. Coema then hugs Eiri and the other maids, and asks where Arukia is. They grow sad, and Eiri explains that she's missing.
214b0cc35c90.t: Di tengah orang ramai, Sora ternampak Coema dan berlari mendahului Eiri untuk memeluknya. Coema kemudian memeluk Eiri dan pembantu rumah lain, dan bertanya di mana Arukia. Mereka menjadi sedih, dan Eiri menerangkan bahawa dia hilang.

240b0e084085.en: Yosuke: "So you two are the new ones, huh?" Harry and Dalila introduce themselves, and so do the two bartenders, Hanako and Mimi, and the sub chef, Rimir.
240b0e084085.t: Yosuke: “Jadi korang berdua yang baru, ya?” Harry dan Dalila memperkenalkan diri, begitu juga dua pelayan bar, Hanako dan Mimi, dan sub chef, Rimir.

24be5ed1659d.en: Deep in the night, Eori, curled up in a dirty blanket, stares at a paddle
24be5ed1659d.t: Lewat malam, Eori, meringkuk dalam selimut kotor, merenung sebatang pendayung

24ef0904a713.en: Ryo hugs the sisters as they watch Soul Energy Art
24ef0904a713.t: Ryo memeluk dua beradik itu ketika mereka menonton Seni Tenaga Jiwa

2605763bd534.en: Harry cuts fish, and Yosuke compares him to Dalila
2605763bd534.t: Harry memotong ikan, dan Yosuke membandingkannya dengan Dalila

262c3ef875d5.en: They walk slowly. Wagons and Eguas pass by. A whiff of manure drifts by now and then, but the ground is spotless by comparison: the poop bags really keep things clean.
262c3ef875d5.t: Mereka berjalan perlahan-lahan. Gerabak dan Egua lalu. Bau tahi kuda sekali-sekala melintas, tetapi tanahnya bersih sekali sebagai perbandingan: beg tahi itu memang menjaga kebersihan.

27571a7dc71e.en: Eiri and Sora drink tea with Coema
27571a7dc71e.t: Eiri dan Sora minum teh bersama Coema

278f52910463.en: Ryo and an adventurer on the road with two Saynas that look like the sisters; one of them is silent as a rock
278f52910463.t: Ryo dan seorang pengembara dalam perjalanan bersama dua ekor Sayna yang mirip dua beradik itu; salah seekor senyap seperti batu

27f00c96bf35.en: Katsumi grabs her sister's hand. Ryo drops the letter. "Does she remember now?" Katsumi goes to grab the letter to rip it apart, but her sister holds her hands. "Why? He's dead already! This is our chance." Katsumi loses her grip on the contract and cries her heart out.
27f00c96bf35.t: Katsumi menggenggam tangan adiknya. Ryo menjatuhkan surat itu. “Dia dah ingat sekarang?” Katsumi hendak mencapai surat itu untuk mengoyaknya, tetapi adiknya memegang tangannya. “Kenapa? Dia dah mati! Ini peluang kita.” Katsumi terlepas genggaman pada kontrak itu dan menangis sepuas-puasnya.

27f551044502.en: Harry tries the window, but it's sealed tight. Meanwhile, Takeo does the same to the other bandit, but instead of spitting it out, he savors it longer. "That's a good blend of Freeish and Sanbi."
27f551044502.t: Harry mencuba tingkap, tetapi ia tertutup rapat. Sementara itu, Takeo melakukan perkara yang sama kepada penyamun yang seorang lagi, tetapi bukannya meludahkannya, dia menikmatinya lebih lama. “Campuran Freeish dan Sanbi yang bagus.”

288eb7d4832f.en: Harry rubs his hand: he wants to ask more, but isn't sure. July notices. "Did he snap one of your fingers?" Harry nods. "All five." July holds his hands. "They're back now, so that's what matters. You wanna go dancing?"
288eb7d4832f.t: Harry menggosok tangannya: dia mahu bertanya lebih, tetapi tidak pasti. July perasan. “Dia patahkan salah satu jari kau ke?” Harry mengangguk. “Kelima-limanya.” July memegang tangannya. “Dah tumbuh balik sekarang, jadi itu yang penting. Kau nak pergi menari?”

295efb33b4dd.en: Suddenly a sheet flies up into the air, and Dalila, looking very focused, sprints to the bathroom as fast as she can, winning the daily rush. "SUCKERS!" Her strained voice carries through the wall.
295efb33b4dd.t: Tiba-tiba sehelai cadar melayang ke udara, dan Dalila, nampak sangat fokus, memecut ke bilik air sepantas mungkin, memenangi perlumbaan harian. “PADAN MUKA!” Suaranya yang meneran kedengaran melalui dinding.

29e58fba6adf.en: Katsumi: "Homeegg! I want to see that too!" Ryo: "Tomorrow's the tournament finale. Princess Maiara is on one of the teams, so I bet it'll be pretty crowded. Are you sure you want to go?" Katsuki doesn't want to; Katsumi tries to get her to come, but she won't. Ryo: "It's because of Sanbi, right?" Katsuki agrees: she still doesn't feel right about fucking Harry over.
29e58fba6adf.t: Katsumi: “Homeegg! Aku nak tengok tu juga!” Ryo: “Esok final kejohanan. Puteri Maiara dalam salah satu pasukan, jadi aku jamin akan sesak. Kau pasti nak pergi?” Katsuki tidak mahu; Katsumi cuba mengajaknya, tetapi dia tidak mahu. Ryo: “Sebab Sanbi, kan?” Katsuki bersetuju: dia masih rasa tak sedap hati kerana menganiaya Harry.

2acf887bc255.en: Neferteri, Itagiba, Huneo and Eiri meet
2acf887bc255.t: Neferteri, Itagiba, Huneo dan Eiri bermesyuarat

2c7d29222f38.en: Harry takes a deep breath. "What do you want from me?" "More fingers?" Harry tenses his hand. Takeo laughs. A knock at the door breaks the foul mood.
2c7d29222f38.t: Harry menarik nafas dalam-dalam. “Apa kau nak daripada aku?” “Lebih banyak jari?” Harry menegangkan tangannya. Takeo ketawa. Ketukan di pintu memecahkan suasana busuk itu.

2e354bbaa184.en: They call a wagon and climb in, and start talking plans. Ryo is thinking about buying a bathhouse in Flatland, turning it into a whorehouse, and letting the sisters run it. Katsuki doesn't want to do that kind of stuff anymore. Ryo: then she'll be his companion on his travels.
2e354bbaa184.t: Mereka memanggil gerabak dan naik, dan mula bercakap tentang rancangan. Ryo terfikir untuk membeli rumah mandian di Flatland, menukarnya menjadi rumah pelacuran, dan membiarkan dua beradik itu menguruskannya. Katsuki tidak mahu membuat benda macam itu lagi. Ryo: kalau begitu dia akan jadi teman Ryo dalam pengembaraannya.

32fad55d7b46.en: Chapter 2 - Happiness is another contract away.
32fad55d7b46.t: Bab 2 - Kebahagiaan cuma sejauh satu lagi kontrak.

331753b1badd.en: Harry passes a wall of posted quests, and sees an older picture of himself in the Sanbi eye
331753b1badd.t: Harry melintasi dinding misi yang ditampal, dan nampak gambar lama dirinya dalam Sanbi-eye

350065131733.en: Harry, holding a small gift, finds July at the date spot
350065131733.t: Harry, memegang hadiah kecil, menemui July di tempat temu janji

3534416fbb8b.en: Huneo smiles. "This is my final request: she may use the Darfaries interface." Neferteri glances over the crowd; their eyes tell her she has no choice but to play along. She looks at Eori. "MOOOM! THAT'S UNFAIR!" Tears pool in Eori's eyes. Neferteri closes her eyes and slowly raises her badge, silencing the room. "On behalf of the Sanbi Royals, I declare this trial fair."
3534416fbb8b.t: Huneo tersenyum. “Ini permintaan terakhir saya: dia boleh menggunakan antara muka Darfaries.” Neferteri mengerling orang ramai; mata mereka memberitahunya dia tiada pilihan selain ikut sama. Dia memandang Eori. “MAAAK! TAK ADIL!” Air mata bergenang di mata Eori. Neferteri memejamkan mata dan perlahan-lahan mengangkat lencananya, menyenyapkan bilik. “Bagi pihak Sanbi Royals, beta mengisytiharkan perbicaraan ini adil.”

3789ad7de8a4.en: Harry focuses all his power into his hands, but nothing happens. The tingle in his spine that radiates down through his body is all there, but no flame comes out. Takeo lets out a single, mocking gasp of laughter. "Is that a new CQC?" "Huh?" "Close Quarters Combat. Show me!" Harry looks at his normal-looking hands and concentrates again. Nothing. "I—dunno. Haaa—"
3789ad7de8a4.t: Harry menumpukan seluruh kuasanya ke tangan, tetapi tiada apa berlaku. Rasa geli di tulang belakangnya yang memancar ke seluruh badan ada semuanya, tetapi tiada api keluar. Takeo melepaskan satu ketawa mengejek. “Itu CQC baharu ke?” “Hah?” “Close Quarters Combat. Tunjukkan!” Harry memandang tangannya yang nampak biasa dan menumpukan perhatian lagi. Tiada apa-apa. “Aku—tak tahu. Haaa—”

37913a61d066.en: The adventurer, {WIP-rioAdventGuard}: "Why are you going to such lengths for these two?" Ryo: "'Cause I love 'em. Simple as that." "Even though they're Red Winga whores?" One of the Saynas scratches him. Ryo: "I agree with Katsumi! No need to shit-talk a legitimate profession."
37913a61d066.t: Pengembara itu, {WIP-rioAdventGuard}: “Kenapa kau bersusah payah sangat untuk dua orang ni?” Ryo: “Sebab aku sayang mereka. Semudah itu.” “Walaupun mereka pelacur Red Winga?” Salah seekor Saynas mencakarnya. Ryo: “Aku setuju dengan Katsumi! Tak perlu kutuk pekerjaan yang sah.”

3871c378fc19.en: Takeo, Severino and a few others carry dead bodies wrapped in ice crystals, plus a large Bagarisa, as the sun rises
3871c378fc19.t: Takeo, Severino dan beberapa orang lain mengusung mayat berbalut kristal ais, serta seekor Bagarisa besar, ketika matahari terbit

392de496df46.en: Ryo opens the room he was staying in; there's a letter on the bed
392de496df46.t: Ryo membuka bilik tempat dia menginap; ada sepucuk surat di atas katil

39aab094aed8.en: The captain moves the stick from one corner of his mouth to the other, takes it out (one end is full of teeth marks), snips that end off with scissors and puts it back in his mouth. "We had something not as bad as this before. A scientist was experimenting with nari gels full of all kinds of crap. He went berserk and killed about 20 people slightly north of Blood." The stick rolls to the other side of his mouth, and he interlocks his fingers. "But I don't remember him exploding like a Hifuna beast. In fact, he reverted when the guards pinned him down and injected him with a ton of Nari Refresher."
39aab094aed8.t: Kapten mengalihkan batang itu dari satu sudut mulutnya ke sudut lain, mengeluarkannya (satu hujung penuh kesan gigitan), menggunting hujung itu dan memasukkannya semula ke dalam mulut. “Kita pernah ada sesuatu yang tak seteruk ni dulu. Seorang saintis bereksperimen dengan nari gel penuh macam-macam karut. Dia mengamuk dan bunuh lebih kurang 20 orang sedikit di utara Blood.” Batang itu bergolek ke sisi lain mulutnya, dan dia menyilangkan jari. “Tapi aku tak ingat dia meletup macam Hifuna beast. Malah, dia kembali normal bila pengawal menekannya ke bawah dan menyuntiknya dengan berlambak Nari Refresher.”

3a4c3e09a898.en: He explains how much they'll earn and how much it costs to live at the restaurant. Food is covered, but work clothes aren't: they can pay up front, or it comes out of their salary. If they leave, they return the work clothes for a refund. If they don't, Yosuke has friends who will find them and get the clothes back, and you don't want to meet those friends. He also goes over the dress code and appearance rules.
3a4c3e09a898.t: Dia menerangkan berapa yang akan mereka peroleh dan berapa kos tinggal di restoran itu. Makanan ditanggung, tetapi pakaian kerja tidak: mereka boleh bayar di depan, atau ia dipotong daripada gaji. Jika mereka berhenti, mereka pulangkan pakaian kerja untuk bayaran balik. Jika tidak, Yosuke ada kawan yang akan mencari mereka dan mendapatkan pakaian itu semula, dan kau tak nak jumpa kawan-kawan itu. Dia juga menerangkan kod pakaian dan peraturan penampilan.

3aa8ab17a5a9.en: Arc #3 - Tasty Lie: the author's story notes (spoilers).
3aa8ab17a5a9.t: Arka #3 - Dusta yang Lazat: nota cerita pengarang (bocoran).

3ba718033efb.en: Harry loses it, remembering his Bagarisa friends and the night he couldn't sleep for all the noise they were making. "So you're saying I need to foam at the mouth while growling and grunting?" July laughs. "So you watch Bagarisas do it, or what?" Harry laughs nervously. "Not really. I just saw it once by accident." "Yeah. Sure. Sure. At least take some lessons from them next time." She leans to his ear. "Some girls like it rough." "I'll keep it in mind."
3ba718033efb.t: Harry tak dapat tahan, teringat kawan-kawan Bagarisanya dan malam dia tak dapat tidur sebab bising sangat bunyi mereka. “Jadi kau kata aku kena berbuih mulut sambil menggeram dan mendengus?” July ketawa. “Jadi kau tengok Bagarisa buat ke, atau apa?” Harry ketawa gugup. “Tak sangat. Aku cuma ternampak sekali tak sengaja.” “Ya la. Ya la. Ya la. Sekurang-kurangnya ambil sikit pelajaran daripada mereka lain kali.” Dia membongkok ke telinganya. “Sesetengah perempuan suka kasar.” “Aku akan ingat.”

3bc0b1450cbd.en: Laughter echoes through the restaurant, followed by an uproar of people wanting whatever's being made. Harry forces a chuckle. "Would you like some?" They nod; one smacks their lips in anticipation. "I'll get those right away!" Harry keeps going table to table, taking as many orders as he can and relaying them to the kitchen.
3bc0b1450cbd.t: Ketawa bergema di seluruh restoran, diikuti hiruk-pikuk orang yang mahukan apa saja yang sedang dimasak. Harry memaksa ketawa kecil. “Nak cuba sikit?” Mereka mengangguk; seorang mengecap bibir kerana tidak sabar. “Saya ambilkan segera!” Harry terus dari meja ke meja, mengambil seberapa banyak pesanan yang boleh dan menyampaikannya ke dapur.

3bc237421f16.en: July, Takeo and Francisco at the restaurant
3bc237421f16.t: July, Takeo dan Francisco di restoran

3eaef02a7b3a.en: Severino shows Harry how they cut a tree; Harry follows suit, but isn't as strong. Severino mentions that his son usually comes with him, but right now he's way too gone over Dalila to care about anything else.
3eaef02a7b3a.t: Severino menunjukkan Harry cara mereka menebang pokok; Harry mengikut, tetapi tidak sekuat itu. Severino menyebut anaknya biasanya ikut, tetapi sekarang dia terlalu angau dengan Dalila untuk peduli tentang benda lain.

3f0da94db53c.en: Hanako: "Desmond is scared!" Yosuke: "You all should be! If you screw it up, I'll fire you!" The celebration halts at once: the gravity of the situation just got real. Yosuke: "Now let's get the restaurant ready for dinner." Everyone stands up and flies to their assigned jobs.
3f0da94db53c.t: Hanako: “Desmond takut!” Yosuke: “Korang semua patut takut! Kalau korang rosakkan, aku pecat korang!” Sambutan itu terhenti serta-merta: betapa seriusnya keadaan baru terasa nyata. Yosuke: “Sekarang jom sediakan restoran untuk makan malam.” Semua orang berdiri dan bergegas ke tugas masing-masing.

407183629530.en: More self-reflection: it's too late to bring up the past. Dalila seems fine now, so why hurt her again? And what could he even do if he told everyone? He has no money, he has nothing. He's just a nobody. "DESMOND! GET YOUR ASS BACK IN HERE!" Yosuke calls him in, and he goes.
407183629530.t: Lebih banyak muhasabah diri: sudah terlambat untuk mengungkit masa lalu. Dalila nampak okey sekarang, jadi kenapa nak sakitinya lagi? Dan apa yang dia boleh buat kalau dia beritahu semua orang? Dia tiada duit, dia tiada apa-apa. Dia cuma orang biasa. “DESMOND! MASUK BALIK SINI!” Yosuke memanggilnya masuk, dan dia pergi.

416463ad94bd.en: Severino asks if she has any family left. She doesn't. They invite her to stay and work with them for a while, until she gets back on her feet. Dalila nods; Vitor looks really happy.
416463ad94bd.t: Severino bertanya sama ada dia masih ada keluarga. Tiada. Mereka menjemputnya tinggal dan bekerja dengan mereka buat sementara, sehingga dia bangkit semula. Dalila mengangguk; Vitor nampak sangat gembira.

461392bd3929.en: Ryo, the sisters (in nari gel form) and the adventurer are stopped by a Forway captain
461392bd3929.t: Ryo, dua beradik itu (dalam bentuk nari gel) dan pengembara itu ditahan oleh seorang kapten Forway

4643dde163a2.en: Harry #13 lies in the ferns, looking at the sun, trying to fall asleep
4643dde163a2.t: Harry #13 berbaring di celah pakis, memandang matahari, cuba tidur

47acf8a737cf.en: Yosuke gives the news to Desmond, Dalila, Rimir, Hanako and Mimi
47acf8a737cf.t: Yosuke menyampaikan berita kepada Desmond, Dalila, Rimir, Hanako dan Mimi

4817400ac39a.en: Harry and Dalila in front of The Wood People Picker; Yosuke, the bartenders Hanako and Mimi, and the sub chef, Rimir, at the entrance
4817400ac39a.t: Harry dan Dalila di depan The Wood People Picker; Yosuke, pelayan bar Hanako dan Mimi, dan sub chef, Rimir, di pintu masuk

49a010b459ce.en: Author's note: Eori is growing a spine, going through the same process Maiara and Yacamim went through. Neferteri tries to control the cycle, and is even growing self-aware of it, but part of her can't seem to stop trying to break the cycle in her favor. Eori, meanwhile, is going through the cycle in her own way, and has grown up in some sense, though her negative tendencies build toward emancipation more than just seeking freedom… In a sense, that's an attempt at control as well.
49a010b459ce.t: Nota pengarang: Eori semakin berani bersuara, melalui proses yang sama yang dilalui Maiara dan Yacamim. Neferteri cuba mengawal kitaran itu, malah semakin sedar tentangnya, tetapi sebahagian dirinya seolah-olah tidak dapat berhenti cuba memecahkan kitaran itu demi kepentingannya. Eori, sementara itu, melalui kitaran itu dengan caranya sendiri, dan sudah matang dalam satu segi, walaupun kecenderungan negatifnya lebih membina ke arah pembebasan daripada sekadar mencari kebebasan… Dalam satu segi, itu juga satu cubaan mengawal.

4b9c6f4890ca.en: Itagiba questions Neferteri. "Eori is in a new environment now. It's time to let her move on from the past." "Yeah, but that's a dick move, after you told her to go there." "It was for her own good." Itagiba disagrees. "I dunno. That's gonna backfire." Neferteri: "I digress. Eori will be a true princess once she puts Harry in the past."
4b9c6f4890ca.t: Itagiba menyoal Neferteri. “Eori di persekitaran baharu sekarang. Dah tiba masanya biar dia melupakan masa lalu.” “Ya, tapi itu tindakan bangsat, lepas dinda suruh dia pergi ke sana.” “Itu untuk kebaikannya sendiri.” Itagiba tidak bersetuju. “Entahlah. Itu akan memakan diri.” Neferteri: “Dinda menyimpang. Eori akan jadi puteri sebenar sebaik dia meninggalkan Harry di masa lalu.”

4bd1eb690337.en: Takeo grabs the two bandits by the hair and turns them toward Harry. "Do you know these two?" Harry shakes his head, straining to see their faces. "I—I—no. I—I don't know them." He keeps his distance. Takeo pulls their heads up to his height. "And you two? Do you know him?" Through their pained groans comes a strong, negative-sounding murmur.
4bd1eb690337.t: Takeo mencekak dua penyamun itu pada rambut dan memalingkan mereka ke arah Harry. “Kau kenal dua orang ni?” Harry menggeleng, bersusah payah melihat muka mereka. “Aku—aku—tak. Aku—aku tak kenal mereka.” Dia menjaga jarak. Takeo menarik kepala mereka ke paras ketinggiannya. “Dan korang berdua? Kenal dia?” Melalui erangan kesakitan mereka kedengaran gumaman kuat yang berbunyi seperti tidak.

4c9446992402.en: The roommate is {WIP-eoriRoommate}. Eori puts on a facade. They butt heads from the get-go, and she excuses herself to go to the library.
4c9446992402.t: Rakan sebilik itu ialah {WIP-eoriRoommate}. Eori berpura-pura. Mereka bertelagah dari awal, dan dia meminta diri untuk ke perpustakaan.

4cef50db3806.en: Harry and Dalila at Forway's South Gate; down the street, a massive gate opens onto a road that seems to go on forever
4cef50db3806.t: Harry dan Dalila di Pintu Gerbang Selatan Forway; di hujung jalan, sebuah pintu gerbang besar terbuka ke jalan yang seolah-olah tiada penghujung

4d9c088283e5.en: Harry sweeps out front and sees Magi heading off somewhere
4d9c088283e5.t: Harry menyapu di depan dan nampak Magi menuju ke suatu tempat

4dd209c57c18.en: Ryo with Katsumi, naked, questioning him while her sister puts on clothes
4dd209c57c18.t: Ryo bersama Katsumi, bogel, menyoalnya sementara adiknya memakai pakaian

527bb2159c14.en: Harry #13 leaves the Bagarisa on his plate untouched and eats the rest
527bb2159c14.t: Harry #13 membiarkan Bagarisa di pinggannya tidak bersentuh dan makan yang lain

5410f0962f7d.en: Ryo: "Leave it to me. I'll find a way for all of us to sit down and enjoy a meal together one day." Katsuki's smile shines as bright as the sun. Ryo checks his watch. "The night is young. Let's go see some Soul Energy Art!" The sisters agree.
5410f0962f7d.t: Ryo: “Serahkan pada aku. Aku akan cari cara supaya kita semua boleh duduk dan nikmati makan bersama suatu hari nanti.” Senyuman Katsuki bersinar seterang matahari. Ryo memeriksa jamnya. “Malam masih muda. Jom pergi tengok Soul Energy Art!” Dua beradik itu bersetuju.

5469bd0d0c9b.en: Eori comes up in the conversation. Huneo proposes canceling Harry's search quest. Eiri votes no, Neferteri yes, Itagiba no: they reach an impasse. Eiri doesn't like that Neferteri is now voting against it.
5469bd0d0c9b.t: Eori disebut dalam perbualan. Huneo mencadangkan membatalkan misi pencarian Harry. Eiri mengundi tidak, Neferteri ya, Itagiba tidak: mereka menemui jalan buntu. Eiri tidak suka Neferteri kini mengundi menentangnya.

54be68f525ef.en: Harry fumbles his lines. July takes over, wraps herself around his arm and starts talking. She notices the gift, takes it and puts it on: she says she didn't need one, but she appreciates the effort. She feels Harry tense up.
54be68f525ef.t: Harry tergagap-gagap dengan ayatnya. July mengambil alih, membelit lengannya dan mula bercakap. Dia perasan hadiah itu, mengambilnya dan memakainya: dia kata dia tak perlukan pun, tetapi dia hargai usaha itu. Dia rasa Harry menjadi tegang.

54d17623ffca.en: Ryo turns back to Maicon. "Let me get to the point. Let's say a friend of yours found two delightful Red Winga working girls, and he wants to make a new contract instead." Maicon turns serious. "That friend of mine is a fucking lunatic." "Sure. Let's say that. What would a fucking lunatic do to get these two ladies out of a Red Winga contract?" Maicon runs his greasy hands through his beard, then licks them clean, thinking. "A fucking lunatic would agree to a fucking lunatic plan." Ryo smiles. "I bet he would."
54d17623ffca.t: Ryo berpaling semula kepada Maicon. “Biar aku terus terang. Katakanlah seorang kawan kau jumpa dua gadis kerja Red Winga yang menawan, dan dia nak buat kontrak baharu sebaliknya.” Maicon menjadi serius. “Kawan aku tu gila celaka.” “Ya la. Katakanlah macam tu. Apa yang orang gila celaka akan buat untuk keluarkan dua wanita ni daripada kontrak Red Winga?” Maicon meraup janggutnya dengan tangan berminyak, kemudian menjilatnya bersih, berfikir. “Orang gila celaka akan setuju dengan rancangan gila celaka.” Ryo tersenyum. “Aku yakin dia akan setuju.”

5561e5ecd719.en: Harry says sorry, but it doesn't matter: Eori squeezes the life out of him, and he can't breathe. Suddenly Takeo appears and starts snapping off his fingers.
5561e5ecd719.t: Harry minta maaf, tetapi tidak penting: Eori memerah nyawanya, dan dia tidak boleh bernafas. Tiba-tiba Takeo muncul dan mula mematahkan jari-jarinya.

55991528afa7.en: They talk about the peonage system. She talks about all the opportunities out in the world! She talks about her adventuring, and about how Takeo was celebrating an important quest he just got, and getting ready to head out.
55991528afa7.t: Mereka bercakap tentang sistem buruh hutang. Dia bercakap tentang semua peluang di luar sana! Dia bercakap tentang pengembaraannya, dan bagaimana Takeo sedang meraikan misi penting yang baru diperolehnya, dan bersiap untuk bertolak.

562d2bf7597b.en: She wants something for dinner, so she goes ahead and buys it for both of them. Harry feels something's off. Wasn't I supposed to buy dinner? Wait! Does she know I don't have any balls?
562d2bf7597b.t: Dia mahu sesuatu untuk makan malam, jadi dia terus membelinya untuk mereka berdua. Harry rasa ada yang tak kena. Bukan ke aku yang patut belanja makan malam? Kejap! Dia tahu ke aku tak ada bola?

573b136c0c22.en: She closes her eyes, and sees another trial just like this one, with her own father not protecting her. She's a princess, for fuck's sake. Why bother with the title and all that shit, when it's all a farce?
573b136c0c22.t: Dia memejamkan mata, dan nampak satu lagi perbicaraan sama seperti ini, dengan ayahnya sendiri tidak melindunginya. Dia seorang puteri, celaka. Buat apa susah-susah dengan gelaran dan semua karut tu, kalau semuanya sandiwara?

57b731eb79ca.en: Francisco comes out the door. "Morning, July! Did Takeo leave already?" July flips back to girly and points at a cart in the distance. "Just now!" "That's too bad. I bought a new {WIP-franciscoGift} for him." "He'll be back soon enough, that's for sure." "Are you leaving as well, July?" "Yes, Francisco. Yesterday I contracted a quest to {WIP-julyQuest}." She smiles brightly. But now I wish I hadn't.
57b731eb79ca.t: Francisco keluar dari pintu. “Selamat pagi, July! Takeo dah pergi ke?” July kembali feminin dan menunjuk sebuah kereta di kejauhan. “Baru tadi!” “Sayang sekali. Aku beli {WIP-franciscoGift} baharu untuk dia.” “Dia akan balik tak lama lagi, itu pasti.” “Kau pun nak pergi juga, July?” “Ya, Francisco. Semalam aku ambil kontrak misi untuk {WIP-julyQuest}.” Dia tersenyum ceria. Tapi sekarang aku harap aku tak ambil.

584e5ac2504a.en: Harry: I think I understand her position, but there's no way I can talk about it without raising suspicion. "Can I ask what the story's about?" Severino tells the story of the three sisters, who came along and revolutionized Tolerideme's farming with Soul Energy and fish meal mixed with human poop. The tie-in: whatever their bodies looked like, those sisters had bright minds and wills as strong as rock. Severino is pushing Harry (and Vitor) to think about the mind behind the body, not just the looks.
584e5ac2504a.t: Harry: Rasanya aku faham kedudukan dia, tapi tak mungkin aku boleh cakap pasal tu tanpa menimbulkan syak. “Boleh aku tanya kisah tu pasal apa?” Severino menceritakan kisah tiga beradik perempuan, yang datang dan merevolusikan pertanian Tolerideme dengan Tenaga Jiwa dan tepung ikan dicampur tahi manusia. Kaitannya: apa pun rupa badan mereka, tiga beradik itu ada minda yang cerdas dan tekad sekuat batu. Severino mendorong Harry (dan Vitor) untuk memikirkan minda di sebalik badan, bukan sekadar rupa.

59f10b542ced.en: She kisses him as the song ends, and the musicians start rotating. She hugs him tight. "That was fun!" She interlocks their fingers and speaks into his ear: "I'm at a hostel nearby. Let's get to know each other better?" Harry smiles, too excited to think it through.
59f10b542ced.t: Dia mencium Harry ketika lagu tamat, dan para pemuzik mula bertukar giliran. Dia memeluknya erat. “Seronoknya!” Dia menyilangkan jari mereka dan berkata di telinganya: “Aku tinggal di asrama dekat sini. Jom kenal lebih rapat?” Harry tersenyum, terlalu teruja untuk berfikir panjang.

5a7330b284ff.en: Takeo snaps back from his own finger-snapping thoughts. "I didn't taste anything weird." "Did you even ask anything?" "Why would I? People lie, but their souls don't." The captain takes his feet off the desk, pulls out a specific contract with sapphires set in its corners, and starts scribbling. "Fair point. I'm gonna give you a Sapphire-level quest."
5a7330b284ff.t: Takeo tersentak kembali daripada fikirannya sendiri tentang mematahkan jari. “Aku tak rasa apa-apa yang pelik.” “Kau ada tanya apa-apa pun?” “Kenapa nak tanya? Orang menipu, tapi jiwa mereka tak.” Kapten menurunkan kakinya dari meja, mengeluarkan sebuah kontrak khas dengan sapphire di bucunya, dan mula menconteng. “Betul juga. Aku akan bagi kau misi peringkat Sapphire.”

5aef386ff2f7.en: Eori turns and starts climbing. Step by step, she feels herself pulling ahead of him; a good, tickly feeling hits her brain. She smiles creepily and giggles as she picks up her pace.
5aef386ff2f7.t: Eori berpaling dan mula mendaki. Langkah demi langkah, dia merasakan dirinya mendahului lelaki itu; perasaan geli yang menyenangkan menyerang otaknya. Dia tersenyum menyeramkan dan ketawa kecil ketika mempercepatkan langkahnya.

5b184823ef82.en: Sora starts following them, cutely embarrassed. Coema aggressively asks what she wants. Sora: "I live with Eiri too." Coema laughs. "So you two are like that?" Eiri: "Don't worry, we don't make too much noise." Coema laughs as Sora huffs, and they head back to the house.
5b184823ef82.t: Sora mula mengikut mereka, malu dengan comelnya. Coema bertanya dengan garang apa yang dia mahu. Sora: “Aku pun tinggal dengan Eiri.” Coema ketawa. “Jadi korang berdua macam tu?” Eiri: “Jangan risau, kami tak buat bising sangat.” Coema ketawa ketika Sora mendengus, dan mereka pulang ke rumah.

5b58c48fcc2b.en: Harry and July fuck (watering can position), kissing
5b58c48fcc2b.t: Harry dan July bersetubuh (posisi watering can), sambil berciuman

5b61a28356a1.en: They talk about other things. Severino explains that they're splitting everyone up as assistants: "Dalila, please follow Nailah. Desmond, follow me. You over there, you follow X," and so on.
5b61a28356a1.t: Mereka bercakap tentang perkara lain. Severino menerangkan bahawa mereka membahagikan semua orang sebagai pembantu: “Dalila, sila ikut Nailah. Desmond, ikut aku. Kau di sana, kau ikut X,” dan seterusnya.

5bf596341542.en: Harry asks who that is. Severino: Yosuke is an interesting character, but he micromanages everything, which makes his restaurant both popular and unpopular, since he does everything fresh. He's very particular, too: he even bought Wood People wood and brought it down to Nailah to make his plates and pickers, all because he didn't trust anyone else to do it. Harry should visit his restaurant in Forway one day.
5bf596341542.t: Harry bertanya siapa itu. Severino: Yosuke watak yang menarik, tetapi dia mengurus segalanya terlalu terperinci, yang menjadikan restorannya popular dan tidak popular serentak, kerana dia buat semuanya segar. Dia sangat cerewet juga: dia malah membeli Wood People wood dan membawanya turun kepada Nailah untuk membuat pinggan dan pickernya, semuanya kerana dia tidak percaya orang lain membuatnya. Harry patut melawat restorannya di Forway suatu hari nanti.

5c7f1c86f5b8.en: July, displeased, turns her back on him. "Fine! Have it your way! Go die in the Hifuna region!" Takeo climbs into the wagon and sets off. July turns back as his figure shrinks into the distance. "Maybe I'm the one who's wrong—I can't taste people's souls, after all."
5c7f1c86f5b8.t: July, tidak puas hati, membelakangkannya. “Okey! Ikut suka kau! Pergi mati di rantau Hifuna!” Takeo memanjat gerabak dan bertolak. July berpaling semula ketika susuknya mengecil di kejauhan. “Mungkin aku yang salah—aku tak boleh rasa jiwa orang, lagipun.”

5cb905fdc718.en: Dalila, Harry and the Rebula family at an emptied market, the wagon empty too; Severino hands each of them a pouch
5cb905fdc718.t: Dalila, Harry dan keluarga Rebula di pasar yang sudah lengang, gerabak juga kosong; Severino menyerahkan sebuah kantung kepada setiap seorang

5d29340413dd.en: Kibe: "You do realize I'm not paying for your food, right?" Eori's face contorts as she forces the words out. "I am a princess of Sanbi." "So?" "Can I please have some food?" "I can accept that." Kibe signals the bartender.
5d29340413dd.t: Kibe: “Kau sedar kan aku tak bayar makanan kau?” Wajah Eori berkerut ketika dia memaksa kata-kata keluar. “Aku puteri Sanbi.” “Jadi?” “Boleh tolong bagi aku makanan?” “Aku boleh terima tu.” Kibe memberi isyarat kepada pelayan bar.

5d8d819d4c6d.en: They talk about their research, and the girl is caught off guard by Eori's interest. "It's a dead end." Her grandpa, {WIP-roommateGrandpa}, was fascinated by it, but one day he disappeared. All that was left were used nari stones, and what looked like an explosion inside the shack where he ran his experiments.
5d8d819d4c6d.t: Mereka bercakap tentang penyelidikan mereka, dan gadis itu terkejut dengan minat Eori. “Itu jalan buntu.” Datuknya, {WIP-roommateGrandpa}, terpesona dengannya, tetapi suatu hari dia hilang. Yang tinggal hanyalah batu nari terpakai, dan apa yang kelihatan seperti letupan di dalam pondok tempat dia menjalankan eksperimennya.

5e2992e0c574.en: Ryo looks around the room. Nothing. He reads the letter: an address and a time, with a Red Winga stamp. Nothing else. He turns to the Pussy Power bandits. "All right. We're done here. You can go."
5e2992e0c574.t: Ryo memandang sekeliling bilik. Tiada apa-apa. Dia membaca surat itu: satu alamat dan satu masa, dengan cop Red Winga. Tiada yang lain. Dia berpaling kepada penyamun Pussy Power. “Okey. Dah selesai di sini. Korang boleh pergi.”

5e493c404c1a.en: Yosuke: "SUB CHEF, WHERE'S THE BROTH?" "WARMFEEL! SMALL TIME CHUNK!" Yosuke looks proud. Dalila looks at Harry with pity. "Are you okay?" "Kinda. I guess I'm terrified of knives." Or rather, of Eori.
5e493c404c1a.t: Yosuke: “SUB CHEF, MANA SUP?” “WARMFEEL! SMALL TIME CHUNK!” Yosuke nampak bangga. Dalila memandang Harry dengan kasihan. “Kau okey?” “Lebih kurang. Rasanya aku takut pisau.” Atau lebih tepat, takut Eori.

5e906f431bbb.en: Harry takes a spoonful of soup and looks at the hanging bandits: one is passed out, another is falling asleep, and the third stares at everyone intently. Harry and the bandit lock eyes; the bandit narrows his. Harry turns back to his soup, and notices the girl on his left with tears on her face. "You okay?"
5e906f431bbb.t: Harry menyuap sesudu sup dan memandang penyamun yang tergantung: seorang pengsan, seorang lagi hampir tertidur, dan yang ketiga merenung semua orang dengan tajam. Harry dan penyamun itu bertentang mata; penyamun itu mengecilkan matanya. Harry kembali kepada supnya, dan perasan gadis di sebelah kirinya dengan air mata di wajah. “Kau okey?”

5f9c9d4a5674.en: Harry watches her, and when he sees her tattered clothes, he realizes she's the same girl from before. He thinks of July again, whose clothes were impeccable by comparison. Maybe not all adventurers have it good.
5f9c9d4a5674.t: Harry memerhatinya, dan apabila dia nampak pakaiannya yang compang-camping, dia sedar itu gadis yang sama dari tempoh hari. Dia teringat July lagi, yang pakaiannya sempurna sebagai perbandingan. Mungkin bukan semua pengembara hidup senang.

605879ad80b6.en: Everyone gets excited. Harry doesn't know what it is, so they explain it to him: Sanbi's {WIP-sanbiHomeeggTeam}, led by Princess Maiara, versus {WIP-rivalHomeeggTeam}, led by {WIP-rivalHomeeggCaptain}. A deep sinking feeling hits Harry; cold sweat takes over his body, and his hands start trembling.
605879ad80b6.t: Semua orang teruja. Harry tidak tahu apa itu, jadi mereka menerangkannya: {WIP-sanbiHomeeggTeam} dari Sanbi, diketuai Puteri Maiara, menentang {WIP-rivalHomeeggTeam}, diketuai {WIP-rivalHomeeggCaptain}. Rasa tenggelam yang dalam menyerang Harry; peluh dingin menguasai badannya, dan tangannya mula menggeletar.

62826a2a2661.en: Ryo and the sisters in front of Yosuke's restaurant, closed
62826a2a2661.t: Ryo dan dua beradik itu di depan restoran Yosuke, ditutup

6287379ae569.en: Emelia: "Glad you came." Ryo explains: they can sign a contract to hand over Harry if they find him. The plan is to make Katsumi famous so that Harry finds them, and since her sister will travel with Ryo, there's a chance there as well.
6287379ae569.t: Emelia: “Gembira kau datang.” Ryo menerangkan: mereka boleh menandatangani kontrak untuk menyerahkan Harry jika mereka menjumpainya. Rancangannya ialah menjadikan Katsumi terkenal supaya Harry menjumpai mereka, dan kerana adiknya akan mengembara bersama Ryo, ada peluang di situ juga.

62e4254afc43.en: Takeo pins Harry against the wall with his arm and snaps off his fingers
62e4254afc43.t: Takeo menekan Harry ke dinding dengan lengannya dan mematahkan jari-jarinya

6373785bbac5.en: Severino hands each of them a pouch of balls. "Thank you, Dalila and Desmond. Desmond, it's been great cutting wood with you, and Dalila, you taught us a lot today with your merchant skills." Vitor, slightly flustered: "T—thank you." Nailah: "And thank you for helping me with the wood carving."
6373785bbac5.t: Severino menyerahkan sebuah kantung bola kepada setiap seorang. “Terima kasih, Dalila dan Desmond. Desmond, seronok tebang kayu dengan kau, dan Dalila, kau ajar kami banyak hari ni dengan kemahiran berniaga kau.” Vitor, sedikit menggelabah: “T—terima kasih.” Nailah: “Dan terima kasih tolong aku mengukir kayu.”

637be5b956e0.en: "But how will we do it?" Coema: "We fight fire with fire—stoking Eori's fire against her own mother, just like I did with Yacamim and Maiara." Eiri is amazed. "I thought that was Itagiba's spirit in them." "A good chunk of it. All I did was push them in the right direction. All we need to do is find Arukia." "WHAT?" "It's clear as day she was involved, and knows what really happened between them." "But Itanema told me—" "Meh—meh—this—meh—meh—that—Itanema is lying! She's a pawn for Neferteri! Anyone can be, for the right price! Even you!" She points at Sora.
637be5b956e0.t: “Tapi macam mana kita nak buat?” Coema: “Kita lawan api dengan api—menyemarakkan api Eori terhadap ibunya sendiri, sama macam aku buat dengan Yacamim dan Maiara.” Eiri kagum. “Aku ingat itu semangat Itagiba dalam diri mereka.” “Sebahagian besarnya. Aku cuma tolak mereka ke arah yang betul. Apa kita perlu buat cuma cari Arukia.” “APA?” “Jelas sekali dia terlibat, dan tahu apa sebenarnya berlaku antara mereka.” “Tapi Itanema beritahu aku—” “Bla—bla—ini—bla—bla—itu—Itanema menipu! Dia bidak Neferteri! Sesiapa pun boleh jadi, dengan harga yang betul! Kau pun!” Dia menunjuk Sora.

656fc9074f52.en: A painful slap wakes Harry up. "I'm trying to sleep!" A fatass Dalila turns over and goes back to sleep. Harry looks around the room, tinted dark by the green moon. Eori isn't torturing him. He's a free man…
656fc9074f52.t: Satu tamparan yang menyakitkan membangunkan Harry. “Aku nak tidur!” Dalila yang gemuk berpaling dan tidur semula. Harry memandang sekeliling bilik, digelapkan oleh bulan hijau. Eori tidak menyeksanya. Dia lelaki yang bebas…

663b00beb4af.en: Eori didn't get a consent form for the experiment she was performing under Huneo's directive, and then she killed Huneo. At the trial, Huneo decides her punishment: swim to the base of Waterfall, then climb the Cliff Walk (Waterfall › Points of interest) (10,764 steps) without nari gels. Eori: "IMPOSSIBLE!"
663b00beb4af.t: Eori tidak mendapatkan borang persetujuan untuk eksperimen yang dijalankannya di bawah arahan Huneo, dan kemudian dia membunuh Huneo. Di perbicaraan, Huneo memutuskan hukumannya: berenang ke kaki Waterfall, kemudian mendaki Cliff Walk (Waterfall › Points of interest) (10,764 anak tangga) tanpa nari gel. Eori: “MUSTAHIL!”

66481d50380c.en: The captain takes out a clean Steen branch and starts chewing as everyone waits in silence. Takeo looks at the guards, then at the captain, who's enjoying his chew. "Are you going to issue a quest for me or not?"
66481d50380c.t: Kapten mengeluarkan sebatang dahan Steen yang bersih dan mula mengunyah sementara semua orang menunggu dalam senyap. Takeo memandang para pengawal, kemudian kapten, yang sedang menikmati kunyahannya. “Kau nak keluarkan misi untuk aku atau tak?”

66773237a8e9.en: Harry sees a backlog of people at the entrance. He looks at Dalila, panting from overstuffing herself. "Do we wait in line too?" "We don't have badges." Dalila heads east. Harry watches someone show his badge to a guard and walk through, then follows her.
66773237a8e9.t: Harry nampak orang beratur panjang di pintu masuk. Dia memandang Dalila, yang tercungap-cungap kerana terlebih makan. “Kita pun beratur ke?” “Kita tak ada lencana.” Dalila menuju ke timur. Harry memerhati seseorang menunjukkan lencananya kepada pengawal dan berjalan masuk, kemudian mengikutnya.

66d6c732f713.en: Katsumi: "Did you rat on us?" She points at Ryo's face, ready to pounce. Ryo, surveying their petite bodies: "I just talked with a contact of mine, and it seems his tongue is weaker than I thought—quicker, too." He hands them the letter. "We need to find and turn in the target who was with you."
66d6c732f713.t: Katsumi: “Kau ke yang bocorkan pasal kami?” Dia menuding muka Ryo, bersedia menerkam. Ryo, meninjau badan mereka yang kecil molek: “Aku cuma bercakap dengan seorang kenalan aku, dan nampaknya lidah dia lebih lemah daripada yang aku sangka—lebih cepat juga.” Dia menyerahkan surat itu kepada mereka. “Kita perlu cari dan serahkan sasaran yang bersama korang.”

66e1adffba40.en: Severino: "Do you really need to take her finger off? Can't you just suck on it, like the others?" "Yes. Now give me your hand, and I'll make it quick." Severino covers his son's eyes, and Nailah looks away. Dalila holds out her hand.
66e1adffba40.t: Severino: “Perlu ke kau cabut jari dia? Tak boleh hisap saja, macam yang lain?” “Perlu. Sekarang bagi tangan kau, dan aku buat cepat.” Severino menutup mata anaknya, dan Nailah memandang ke arah lain. Dalila menghulurkan tangannya.

67178c62530e.en: Eiri: "But how?" Coema: "By pulling a girl's heartstrings." Eiri will contact Arukia's family again and ask if Arukia has made contact. They'll say no, and that's the moment to infuse them with money to make announcements throughout the kingdom. They'll have to comply either way, and Neferteri will be livid.
67178c62530e.t: Eiri: “Tapi macam mana?” Coema: “Dengan menyentuh hati seorang gadis.” Eiri akan menghubungi keluarga Arukia lagi dan bertanya sama ada Arukia ada menghubungi mereka. Mereka akan kata tidak, dan itulah saatnya menyuntik mereka dengan wang untuk membuat pengumuman di seluruh kerajaan. Mereka perlu akur apa pun, dan Neferteri akan berang.

67d8348c1728.en: Harry jumps on it. His scalp itches as new hair is pumped through, and the stylist cuts it short. When it's time to shave his beard, Harry's PTSD kicks in. The stylist asks what's wrong; Harry won't say. The stylist gives him Steen to relax, then cuts the beard.
67d8348c1728.t: Harry terus menyambarnya. Kulit kepalanya gatal ketika rambut baharu dipam keluar, dan pendandan memotongnya pendek. Apabila tiba masa mencukur janggutnya, PTSD Harry datang. Pendandan bertanya apa yang tak kena; Harry tidak mahu beritahu. Pendandan memberinya Steen untuk bertenang, kemudian memotong janggut itu.

68faa29913d5.en: Eori stands up to head back to the stairs
68faa29913d5.t: Eori berdiri untuk kembali ke tangga

698d8c44b9f2.en: Yosuke asks Harry to show his skills. Harry is afraid of the knife; bad memories creep in, and he slices off a huge chunk. Yosuke: "AWFUL!" He shows Harry how it's done. "AGAIN!" Harry tries again, but he's sloppy: he's afraid of the knife, and the bad memories creep in. "GET OUT!" "Sorry, chef." Harry goes to take orders.
698d8c44b9f2.t: Yosuke menyuruh Harry menunjukkan kemahirannya. Harry takut pada pisau; ingatan buruk menjalar masuk, dan dia memotong seketul besar. Yosuke: “TERUK!” Dia menunjukkan Harry cara yang betul. “LAGI!” Harry mencuba lagi, tetapi dia cuai: dia takut pada pisau, dan ingatan buruk menjalar masuk. “KELUAR!” “Maaf, chef.” Harry pergi mengambil pesanan.

6a57d0e1c66e.en: Coema is back from Newland. Eiri asks how it's going. Coema describes a rough sea journey, but the Cruro guild she belongs to is gaining a nice foothold in the trade of {WIP-giantSlothLike} skin (a beast kinda like a giant sloth). Then she turns to what happened while she was gone. Eiri hesitates, but opens up after Sora eggs her on.
6a57d0e1c66e.t: Coema baru kembali dari Newland. Eiri bertanya bagaimana keadaannya. Coema menceritakan pelayaran laut yang sukar, tetapi persatuan Cruro yang disertainya semakin kukuh dalam perdagangan kulit {WIP-giantSlothLike} (sejenis makhluk buas seperti sloth gergasi). Kemudian dia beralih kepada apa yang berlaku semasa dia tiada. Eiri teragak-agak, tetapi berterus terang selepas Sora mendesaknya.

6ac3fa064ad5.t: Sumber: Legacy/Behind The Scenes/Light Novel/Arc #3 - Tasty Lie.md

6b0f9464a8d4.en: Ryo and the sisters, after the talk
6b0f9464a8d4.t: Ryo dan dua beradik itu, selepas perbincangan

6cbbceb0de4a.en: He closes the door, and a rustling comes from the ceiling. He looks for open cracks, but there are none. He drops to the floor, checks the base of the wall, and finds a hole about the size of a Sayna.
6cbbceb0de4a.t: Dia menutup pintu, dan bunyi gemersik datang dari siling. Dia mencari rekahan terbuka, tetapi tiada. Dia meniarap ke lantai, memeriksa kaki dinding, dan menemui lubang lebih kurang sebesar seekor Sayna.

6cf01797ec9b.en: Author's note: Magi is an unnamed cameo in the background of this scene's illustration.
6cf01797ec9b.t: Nota pengarang: Magi ialah kemunculan ringkas tanpa nama di latar belakang ilustrasi babak ini.

6ee8887b154d.en: Eori, in a loud whisper: "What the fuck is his problem?" Kibe points at the sign behind her. Eori reads the lovely poster: "Couples who climb together, stay together." Kibe: "It's a thing for some people. Just ignore it."
6ee8887b154d.t: Eori, berbisik kuat: “Apa celaka masalah dia?” Kibe menunjuk papan tanda di belakangnya. Eori membaca poster yang manis itu: “Pasangan yang mendaki bersama, kekal bersama.” Kibe: “Benda ni penting bagi sesetengah orang. Abaikan saja.”

6f1c5788eea8.en: They bicker until Eiri walks in. After a tangent, Eiri tells them the Tolerideme family is coming to visit, and that Eori is leaving for Forway, so they need to wash all her clothes and have everything ready for when she arrives. The maids ask why. Eiri: "Neferteri decided it was best for her."
6f1c5788eea8.t: Mereka bertengkar sehingga Eiri masuk. Selepas melencong cerita, Eiri memberitahu mereka keluarga Tolerideme akan datang melawat, dan Eori akan bertolak ke Forway, jadi mereka perlu membasuh semua pakaiannya dan menyediakan segalanya untuk ketibaannya. Para pembantu rumah bertanya kenapa. Eiri: “Neferteri memutuskan itu yang terbaik untuknya.”

6f788745ca15.en: Harry, Dalila and Yosuke in the restaurant's attic
6f788745ca15.t: Harry, Dalila dan Yosuke di loteng restoran

6f7d9ee5fd52.en: The sisters, as Saynas, fight Sorenos
6f7d9ee5fd52.t: Dua beradik itu, sebagai Sayna, melawan Soreno

71c00d66b5cd.en: Takeo walks toward Harry, clicking his pliers. Harry, backed against the wall, can't get a word out. Takeo pushes him up the wall with one hand and takes off one of his fingers with the other. He loves the taste. Harry fights to break free, to no avail.
71c00d66b5cd.t: Takeo berjalan ke arah Harry, mendetikkan playarnya. Harry, tersandar ke dinding, tidak dapat mengeluarkan sepatah kata. Takeo menolaknya naik ke dinding dengan sebelah tangan dan mencabut salah satu jarinya dengan tangan yang lagi satu. Dia suka rasanya. Harry bergelut untuk melepaskan diri, sia-sia.

73af71d73b40.en: Katsuki doesn't feel safe. Ryo: "Relax. We spent all day having fun. Did you even see anyone suspicious?" Katsuki: "O—ne. F—five." "She's getting the hang of it pretty quick. Nice!" (Katsuki's speech pattern uses counters: that's how she gets the words out.) He hugs her from the side. "What did you two enjoy most today?" Katsuki: "O—ne. Ev—ery—thing." They talk about how they'd never seen the Black Tower up close (Forway Palace, the giant tower at the center of Forway, where all business and administration flows through).
73af71d73b40.t: Katsuki tidak rasa selamat. Ryo: “Bertenang. Kita habiskan sepanjang hari berseronok. Kau ada nampak sesiapa yang mencurigakan?” Katsuki: “Sa—tu. Li—ma.” “Dia cepat menguasainya. Bagus!” (Cara Katsuki bercakap menggunakan bilangan: itulah caranya dia mengeluarkan kata-kata.) Dia memeluknya dari sisi. “Apa yang korang berdua paling seronok hari ni?” Katsuki: “Sa—tu. Se—mu—a.” Mereka bercakap tentang bagaimana mereka tidak pernah melihat Black Tower dari dekat (Forway Palace, menara gergasi di tengah-tengah Forway, tempat semua perniagaan dan pentadbiran melaluinya).

740c8b0dec3c.en: The guards close in on Eori, and she swings her cuffed arms around. "DON'T TOUCH ME!" She walks out, back toward the castle.
740c8b0dec3c.t: Pengawal menghampiri Eori, dan dia menghayun lengannya yang bergari. “JANGAN SENTUH AKU!” Dia keluar, kembali ke arah istana.

742a906cb4bb.en: A bartender comes into the kitchen, reads off an order of mains and sides, and sticks the ticket on a hook in the wall. Yosuke: "COMING RIGHT UP! SUB CHEF, SIDES, ASAP!" "YES, CHEF!"
742a906cb4bb.t: Seorang pelayan bar masuk ke dapur, membacakan pesanan hidangan utama dan sampingan, dan mencucuk tiket itu pada cangkuk di dinding. Yosuke: “SIAP SEKEJAP LAGI! SUB CHEF, SAMPINGAN, SEGERA!” “BAIK, CHEF!”

74a67d8e9326.en: "Yo! Good luck!" A familiar voice. She stops, and Kibe strolls leisurely past her and keeps going. Anger builds. "WHAT THE FUCK IS YOUR PROBLEM?" Kibe turns his head. "Mine? None?"
74a67d8e9326.t: “Yo! Semoga berjaya!” Suara yang biasa didengar. Dia berhenti, dan Kibe bersiar-siar santai melepasinya dan terus naik. Kemarahan memuncak. “APA CELAKA MASALAH KAU?” Kibe menoleh. “Aku? Tak ada?”

77cc4b47ee9c.en: Harry looks at the Bagarisa meat; his stomach turns and something rises in his throat. He vividly sees the Bagarisa friends he once had: those days were short-lived, but carefree. "Desmond? Desmond?" Severino breaks through his scattered thoughts. "Oh, sorry. I was trying to remember some things."
77cc4b47ee9c.t: Harry memandang daging Bagarisa; perutnya memulas dan sesuatu naik ke tekaknya. Dia nampak dengan jelas kawan-kawan Bagarisa yang pernah dimilikinya: hari-hari itu singkat, tetapi bebas daripada kerisauan. “Desmond? Desmond?” Severino memecahkan fikirannya yang berselerak. “Oh, maaf. Aku cuba ingat beberapa benda.”

78441d73c205.en: Ryo and the sisters go clothes shopping
78441d73c205.t: Ryo dan dua beradik itu membeli-belah pakaian

78a765916e71.en: Chapter 5 - All roads lead to Forway
78a765916e71.t: Bab 5 - Semua jalan menuju ke Forway

79e8ce55d3db.en: She thinks about killing Kibe, burying his body, then reporting that Cruros attacked him; she thinks about how she'd injure herself to back up her story.
79e8ce55d3db.t: Dia terfikir membunuh Kibe, menanam mayatnya, kemudian melaporkan bahawa Cruro menyerangnya; dia terfikir bagaimana dia akan mencederakan dirinya sendiri untuk menyokong ceritanya.

7b05c83b6b07.en: Harry messes up and starts bleeding, and he doesn't heal like before. Yosuke: "DON'T BLEED OVER THE VEGETABLES!" That triggers a panic attack. Rimir, the sub chef, casts a heal, and Harry's hand closes up. Yosuke, from the other corner: "SUCK IT UP! TRY AGAIN!" Sub chef: "Wash the blood off the vegetables, or it'll change the taste." Harry carefully does as he's told.
7b05c83b6b07.t: Harry tersilap dan mula berdarah, dan dia tidak sembuh seperti dahulu. Yosuke: “JANGAN BERDARAH ATAS SAYUR!” Itu mencetuskan serangan panik. Rimir, si sub chef, melempar jampi penyembuhan, dan tangan Harry tertutup semula. Yosuke, dari sudut lain: “TAHAN SAJA! CUBA LAGI!” Sub chef: “Basuh darah dari sayur tu, nanti rasanya berubah.” Harry dengan berhati-hati menurut perintah.

7b1fe1226dc7.en: Nailah: "I made plenty today. Thank you, Dalila and Desmond." Severino: "It's been a great help. Tomorrow we're going to sell a lot at {VillageSouthOfForway}. On that note, Nailah?" Nailah remembers something. "By the way, {WIP-nailahMessenger} came back from Forway. Yosuke wants to hire both of you." Dalila stops eating for a second, and a big, greasy smile spreads across her face.
7b1fe1226dc7.t: Nailah: “Aku dah buat banyak hari ni. Terima kasih, Dalila dan Desmond.” Severino: “Sangat membantu. Esok kita akan jual banyak di {VillageSouthOfForway}. Berkenaan itu, Nailah?” Nailah teringat sesuatu. “By the way, {WIP-nailahMessenger} dah balik dari Forway. Yosuke nak upah kedua-dua korang.” Dalila berhenti makan sekejap, dan senyuman besar berminyak terukir di wajahnya.

7b45e260a545.en: Ryo and Maicon at Yosuke's restaurant; Harry takes orders, Dalila in the background
7b45e260a545.t: Ryo dan Maicon di restoran Yosuke; Harry mengambil pesanan, Dalila di belakang

7b502d2a8c71.en: Neferteri adds that in Forway, Eori will have more freedom as well. Eori fights her off for being controlling, and that's how the carrot comes out.
7b502d2a8c71.t: Neferteri menambah bahawa di Forway, Eori akan ada lebih banyak kebebasan juga. Eori melawannya kerana suka mengawal, dan dari situlah lobak merah dikeluarkan.

7c27f3a6c04e.en: Eori gets a strong-willed, take-no-shit-from-anyone roommate
7c27f3a6c04e.t: Eori mendapat rakan sebilik yang berkemauan keras dan tidak bertolak ansur dengan sesiapa

7e15946ee574.en: Eori feels the world crumbling. Without a word, she climbs out into the shallows, sits on the ground, curls up and cries her heart out. Kibe: "This seems like a lot, kinda. You sure you don't want it?"
7e15946ee574.t: Eori rasa dunianya runtuh. Tanpa sepatah kata, dia memanjat keluar ke air cetek, duduk di tanah, meringkuk dan menangis sepuas-puasnya. Kibe: “Nampak macam banyak, lebih kurang. Kau pasti tak nak?”

7f74e40b1370.en: Coema sips her tea, savoring scheming on par with Neferteri, like the old days
7f74e40b1370.t: Coema menghirup tehnya, menikmati muslihat yang setanding Neferteri, seperti zaman dahulu

80ff57c4c6c9.en: Takeo: "I get the whole picture now. This Hifuna beast in Bagarisa form attacked your wagon, then went to the Black Magina farm, where it exploded. Hold out your hand." He takes out pliers, already blood-stained. Dalila looks unsure.
80ff57c4c6c9.t: Takeo: “Aku dah faham gambaran penuhnya sekarang. Hifuna beast dalam bentuk Bagarisa ni serang gerabak kau, kemudian pergi ke ladang Black Magina, tempat ia meletup. Hulurkan tangan kau.” Dia mengeluarkan playar, sudah bernoda darah. Dalila nampak tidak pasti.

82b252a3a5e9.en: Vitor looks at Dalila with worry: she's barely breathing as she shovels food into her face. Maybe she isn't even tasting it, like a dog gulping down food without chewing. He wants to say something, looks at his father, and his father shakes his head. Vitor looks down.
82b252a3a5e9.t: Vitor memandang Dalila dengan risau: dia hampir tidak bernafas ketika menyuap makanan ke mukanya. Mungkin dia tidak pun merasainya, seperti anjing yang menelan makanan tanpa mengunyah. Dia mahu berkata sesuatu, memandang ayahnya, dan ayahnya menggeleng. Vitor menunduk.

8347f8f27ab8.en: Emelia: "Fair enough, but we'll keep close tabs on you three. If you dare give Harry, or anything to do with him, to anyone else, we'll take action. We were the ones who found him. Also, I want the truth about Harry: everything the sisters know about him."
8347f8f27ab8.t: Emelia: “Adil, tapi kami akan perhatikan kamu bertiga dengan rapi. Kalau kamu berani serahkan Harry, atau apa-apa yang berkaitan dengannya, kepada orang lain, kami akan bertindak. Kamilah yang menjumpainya. Juga, aku mahu kebenaran tentang Harry: semua yang dua beradik ini tahu tentangnya.”

854866ac596e.en: Eori doesn't look happy. I want my Harry back.
854866ac596e.t: Eori tidak nampak gembira. Aku nak Harry aku balik.

865e4616715b.en: With a loud crunch, Takeo tosses the thumb in the air and catches it in his mouth, like popcorn. He sits on the bed, wipes the pliers on the sheets and puts them away. "So that's the taste of a pure Naked Brunto. No wonder the Lishies slurped you people up."
865e4616715b.t: Dengan bunyi rangup yang kuat, Takeo melambung ibu jari itu ke udara dan menangkapnya dengan mulut, seperti bertih jagung. Dia duduk di katil, mengelap playar pada cadar dan menyimpannya. “Jadi itulah rasa Naked Brunto tulen. Patutlah Lishies hirup orang-orang macam korang.”

879e36ffc2aa.en: Eori and Neferteri at the top of the stairs
879e36ffc2aa.t: Eori dan Neferteri di puncak tangga

888f8f186ea4.en: Ryo handpicks whatever is cutest for them.
888f8f186ea4.t: Ryo memilih sendiri apa saja yang paling comel untuk mereka.

88f9b56b5e48.en: The guards all look surprised, and Takeo looks pretty interested too. "What am I supposed to do?" The captain keeps writing as if he hadn't heard. A guard leans over and whispers: "He doesn't answer until he finishes whatever he's doing."
88f9b56b5e48.t: Para pengawal semua nampak terkejut, dan Takeo nampak agak berminat juga. “Apa aku kena buat?” Kapten terus menulis seolah-olah tidak mendengar. Seorang pengawal membongkok dan berbisik: “Dia tak jawab sampai dia habiskan apa saja yang dia sedang buat.”

8b2cdb4f0f0d.en: {WIP-katsumiBandit}: "Who the fuck are you? What are you doing to us?" Takeo locks the door. "Let's talk." He looks at the clicking steel pliers and goes to hit him, but he's too weak: Takeo punches him aside, and he hits the wall and falls to the floor, his head bleeding. {WIP-blackMaginaGuy} hesitates to strike back, but Takeo lands a blow to his face that sends him flying toward Harry.
8b2cdb4f0f0d.t: {WIP-katsumiBandit}: “Siapa celaka kau? Apa kau buat pada kami?” Takeo mengunci pintu. “Jom berbincang.” Dia memandang playar keluli yang berdetik dan hendak memukulnya, tetapi dia terlalu lemah: Takeo menumbuknya ke tepi, dan dia menghentam dinding dan jatuh ke lantai, kepalanya berdarah. {WIP-blackMaginaGuy} teragak-agak hendak membalas, tetapi Takeo melepaskan pukulan ke mukanya yang menghantarnya terbang ke arah Harry.

8c6499beee4d.en: Sub chef: "You noticed it too?" Dalila looks at him with concern. "Do you know why?" "I asked, but he said he didn't know—" Yosuke slaps the table. "WE'RE IN THE KITCHEN! I'M NOT GONNA SAY IT AGAIN!" "YES, CHEF! SORRY, CHEF!" the sub chef and Dalila say in unison.
8c6499beee4d.t: Sub chef: “Kau perasan juga?” Dalila memandangnya dengan risau. “Kau tahu kenapa?” “Aku dah tanya, tapi dia kata dia tak tahu—” Yosuke menampar meja. “KITA DI DAPUR! AKU TAK NAK CAKAP LAGI!” “BAIK, CHEF! MAAF, CHEF!” kata sub chef dan Dalila serentak.

8ed682fe9d98.en: The guards let them go. Adventurer: "Why did you lie?" Ryo: "Of course I would. The Red Winga is bigger than you think."
8ed682fe9d98.t: Pengawal melepaskan mereka. Pengembara: “Kenapa kau tipu?” Ryo: “Mestilah aku tipu. Red Winga lebih besar daripada yang kau sangka.”

8f2cfb4fa669.en: With a loud snap, Harry's thumb flies off. "Shit." Takeo lets go of Harry and goes looking for it. Propped against the wall, Harry's knees give out; he falls to the floor, shielding his chopped-up hand as blood keeps pouring out.
8f2cfb4fa669.t: Dengan bunyi patah yang kuat, ibu jari Harry tercampak. “Celaka.” Takeo melepaskan Harry dan pergi mencarinya. Tersandar di dinding, lutut Harry menyerah; dia jatuh ke lantai, melindungi tangannya yang tercincang ketika darah terus mencurah keluar.

904feb15811c.en: A day in, Eori is cold and hungry while Kibe enjoys a nice dinner
904feb15811c.t: Sehari berlalu, Eori sejuk dan lapar sementara Kibe menikmati makan malam yang enak

913c505473cb.en: Ryo, the sisters, Emelia and bandits (in nari gel)
913c505473cb.t: Ryo, dua beradik itu, Emelia dan penyamun (dalam nari gel)

9174697b7d4c.en: Her steps are slow, but steady. Eight hundred and twenty-four—eight hundred and twenty-five—eight hundred and twenty-six. Her mind is set on finishing this trial, nothing more, nothing less. Nothing could possibly shake her focus—
9174697b7d4c.t: Langkahnya perlahan, tetapi tetap. Lapan ratus dua puluh empat—lapan ratus dua puluh lima—lapan ratus dua puluh enam. Fikirannya tertumpu untuk menamatkan ujian ini, tidak lebih, tidak kurang. Tiada apa yang mungkin dapat menggoyahkan tumpuannya—

92b773900bad.en: July's demeanor changes; her cutesy front disappears. "I told you not to bring that up again." "Then what do you want?" "Nobody has a shady past he doesn't want to talk about. I knew he was hiding something the moment I saw him at the restaurant." Takeo: "We all hide something, don't we?" The question is rather suggestive, to say the least.
92b773900bad.t: Sikap July berubah; wajah comelnya hilang. “Aku dah cakap jangan ungkit pasal tu lagi.” “Habis kau nak apa?” “Tak ada orang yang ada masa lalu gelap yang dia tak nak cakap. Aku tahu dia sembunyikan sesuatu sebaik aku nampak dia di restoran.” Takeo: “Kita semua sembunyikan sesuatu, kan?” Soalan itu agak menyindir, untuk berlembut.

92cadf7c2047.en: Panic races through Harry's heart. He looks at his hands and feels a sense of power overwhelming him. In one swift move, he's out of bed and tumbling to the back of the room, putting distance between himself and this monstrous figure. Takeo smiles and clicks his pliers, and the room goes silent.
92cadf7c2047.t: Panik berlumba dalam hati Harry. Dia memandang tangannya dan merasakan kuasa menguasainya. Dengan satu gerakan pantas, dia keluar dari katil dan bergolek ke belakang bilik, menjarakkan dirinya daripada susuk mengerikan ini. Takeo tersenyum dan mendetikkan playarnya, dan bilik itu sunyi.

93243bb1be12.en: Ryo sits down with the sisters, still in Sayna form. "All right, I need you two to pay attention. I'm gonna go get in touch with my Red Winga contact. Hide in the ceiling or somewhere else, and if anyone enters this room, make a mental note of their face, especially any symbols they wear. Understood?" The Saynas bob their cute little heads. He pats them both. "Especially you, Katsumi. Don't do anything rash." He leaves.
93243bb1be12.t: Ryo duduk bersama dua beradik itu, masih dalam bentuk Sayna. “Okey, aku perlukan korang berdua beri perhatian. Aku nak pergi hubungi kenalan Red Winga aku. Sembunyi di siling atau tempat lain, dan kalau ada sesiapa masuk bilik ni, ingat muka mereka, terutamanya apa-apa simbol yang mereka pakai. Faham?” Sayna-sayna itu mengangguk-angguk kepala kecil comel mereka. Dia menepuk kedua-duanya. “Terutamanya kau, Katsumi. Jangan buat apa-apa melulu.” Dia beredar.

93aa4188cd87.en: Severino walks over to Harry. "Do you know who you are?" Harry feels awkward answering; he wonders if they'll send him back to Eori. He shakes his head. Takeo threatens him, but Harry holds firm. Takeo: "All right. You two have a lovely chat. I'm gonna go hand in these two bandits."
93aa4188cd87.t: Severino berjalan ke arah Harry. “Kau tahu siapa diri kau?” Harry rasa janggal hendak menjawab; dia tertanya-tanya sama ada mereka akan menghantarnya balik kepada Eori. Dia menggeleng. Takeo mengugutnya, tetapi Harry bertahan. Takeo: “Okey. Korang berdua berbuallah dengan seronok. Aku nak pergi serahkan dua penyamun ni.”

94df899e5fe8.en: Aurora: "Why is Eiri so down lately?" Sora explains that Huneo won't fund Harry's search quest. Itanema: "Why don't we hold a burial for Harry and put an end to it?" Sora: "I'm not telling her that!"
94df899e5fe8.t: Aurora: “Kenapa Eiri muram sangat kebelakangan ni?” Sora menerangkan bahawa Huneo tidak mahu membiayai misi pencarian Harry. Itanema: “Kenapa kita tak buat upacara pengebumian untuk Harry dan tamatkan saja?” Sora: “Aku tak nak beritahu dia macam tu!”

9839d6927796.en: The guards ask if they saw anything weird in the forest, or talked with anyone who did. Ryo: "We saw tons of broken carts on the road with nobody in sight, so we fled toward Forway." "Did you see the explosion?" "We heard a rumble in the sky, but apparently we were too far south of it. We fled to Deltacross." The captain asks if they're looking for family members. Ryo: "No, just passing through, on my way back home to Flatland." The adventurer holds back and keeps up the lie. (Forway, then Deltacross: Ryo's story slips, because it's all a lie for the guards.)
9839d6927796.t: Para pengawal bertanya sama ada mereka nampak apa-apa yang pelik di hutan, atau bercakap dengan sesiapa yang nampak. Ryo: “Kami nampak banyak kereta rosak di jalan tanpa seorang pun kelihatan, jadi kami lari ke arah Forway.” “Kau nampak letupan tu?” “Kami dengar dentuman di langit, tapi nampaknya kami terlalu jauh di selatan. Kami lari ke Deltacross.” Kapten bertanya sama ada mereka mencari ahli keluarga. Ryo: “Tak, cuma lalu, dalam perjalanan pulang ke Flatland.” Pengembara itu menahan diri dan meneruskan pembohongan itu. (Forway, kemudian Deltacross: cerita Ryo tergelincir, kerana semuanya pembohongan untuk pengawal.)

99048d7242d0.en: Katsuki: "HA—ha—h—ha?" Ryo looks at Katsumi. Katsumi: "Say 'One', then his name." "O—o—ne. Ha—ha—rry?" Ryo: "Do you remember him?" Her eyes waver. Ryo: "Okay. Okay. Sell him to Forway—okay, that sounded bad. We'll negotiate a contract with Forway that's favorable to Harry and to us, in exchange for selling out the Sanbi Kingdom and dishing the dirt on what Eori did to him." Katsuki is unsure, but she smiles. Ryo: "Good. Let's go get this over with."
99048d7242d0.t: Katsuki: “HA—ha—h—ha?” Ryo memandang Katsumi. Katsumi: “Sebut ‘Satu’, kemudian nama dia.” “Sa—sa—tu. Ha—ha—rry?” Ryo: “Kau ingat dia?” Matanya goyah. Ryo: “Okey. Okey. Jual dia kepada Forway—okey, bunyinya teruk. Kita akan runding kontrak dengan Forway yang menguntungkan Harry dan kita, sebagai tukaran membocorkan Kerajaan Sanbi dan membongkar apa yang Eori buat pada dia.” Katsuki tidak pasti, tetapi dia tersenyum. Ryo: “Bagus. Jom selesaikan.”

99182d961248.en: Vitor breaks through his shyness, walks up to Dalila and pats her head. Dalila, eyes red, sniffles as she looks at the flushed boy staring at her.
99182d961248.t: Vitor mengatasi rasa malunya, berjalan ke arah Dalila dan mengusap kepalanya. Dalila, mata merah, teresak-esak ketika memandang budak lelaki yang tersipu-sipu merenungnya.
