9b6b9542c32f.en: Takeo snaps off her ring finger and pops it in his mouth, savoring it like a French person savors wine, rolling the chewed finger from one side of his tongue to the other. "Mostly Tolerideme, with some Wozefaries. You're good." Dalila tears up as her finger grows back. Takeo heads for the door. "I'm gonna check a few more."
9b6b9542c32f.t: Takeo mematahkan jari manisnya dan memasukkannya ke dalam mulut, menikmatinya seperti orang Perancis menikmati wain, menggolek jari yang dikunyah dari satu sisi lidahnya ke sisi yang lain. “Kebanyakannya Tolerideme, dengan sedikit Wozefaries. Kau okey.” Dalila bergenang air mata ketika jarinya tumbuh semula. Takeo menuju ke pintu. “Aku nak periksa beberapa lagi.”

9ce779aba7d4.en: Hanako stands, bends over in front of Harry and points right at his face. "You deserve better than her! I know you do!" Mimi copies her, but her finger-wagging is way more erratic, and somehow more energetic. Harry smiles. "Thank you!" But I'm sorry. I don't deserve it, after what happened.
9ce779aba7d4.t: Hanako berdiri, membongkok di depan Harry dan menuding tepat ke mukanya. “Kau layak dapat lebih baik daripada dia! Aku tahu kau layak!” Mimi menirunya, tetapi goyangan jarinya jauh lebih tidak menentu, dan entah bagaimana lebih bertenaga. Harry tersenyum. “Terima kasih!” Tapi maafkan aku. Aku tak layak, selepas apa yang berlaku.

9d49b4abe24a.en: Eori can't find a way to research the Soul
9d49b4abe24a.t: Eori tidak menemui cara untuk menyelidik Jiwa

9f75e0088386.en: Ryo and the sisters, in Forway clothes, have dinner out in the open
9f75e0088386.t: Ryo dan dua beradik itu, dalam pakaian Forway, makan malam di kawasan lapang

9fca3cad0c72.en: Everything itches. Harry realizes this is his chance to put Harry behind him and start anew. He needs money to change his appearance, and then he'll be all good.
9fca3cad0c72.t: Semuanya gatal. Harry sedar ini peluangnya untuk meninggalkan Harry di belakang dan bermula semula. Dia perlukan duit untuk menukar rupanya, dan kemudian semuanya akan beres.

a02fe8dff969.en: The captain savors his Steen a bit longer before spitting into a nearby bucket. "How did the biopsy go?" Guard: "It's a big, strong, alpha Bagarisa, but it's just a Bagarisa."
a02fe8dff969.t: Kapten menikmati Steennya sedikit lebih lama sebelum meludah ke dalam baldi berdekatan. “Macam mana biopsi tu?” Pengawal: “Ia Bagarisa alfa yang besar dan kuat, tapi ia cuma Bagarisa.”

a070afcb3e46.en: July starts stroking harder against him, tightening her grip. "You're not thinking about another girl, are you?" The gripping, controlled sensation makes Harry uncomfortable; he starts remembering all the times Eori controlled him. He tries to hide it, but July notices. She lets go, sits up on him, takes his hands and places them on her delicate little breasts. "It's okay. Follow my lead."
a070afcb3e46.t: July mula menggesel lebih kuat padanya, mengetatkan cengkamannya. “Kau tak fikir pasal perempuan lain, kan?” Rasa dicengkam dan dikawal itu membuat Harry tidak selesa; dia mula teringat semua kali Eori mengawalnya. Dia cuba menyembunyikannya, tetapi July perasan. Dia melepaskan, duduk di atasnya, mengambil tangannya dan meletakkannya di atas payudaranya yang kecil halus. “Tak apa. Ikut rentak aku.”

a131908d5bc0.en: A wave of goodness spreads through Harry's body as he kisses July deep, but when he opens his eyes, he sees Eori for a split second. July opens her eyes and stares back. "Did my cuteness scare you?" Harry smiles nervously. "No—of course not."
a131908d5bc0.t: Gelombang nikmat merebak ke seluruh badan Harry ketika dia mencium July dalam-dalam, tetapi apabila dia membuka mata, dia nampak Eori sekelip mata. July membuka mata dan merenung balik. “Kecomelan aku buat kau takut ke?” Harry tersenyum gugup. “Tak—mestilah tak.”

a1687c729c5d.en: With some of her energy back, Eori stands, prepares her speech, and releases it in one pent-up breath. "Thank you!" She turns toward the stairs, and with a quick glance sees Kibe planted in his chair, gazing at the horizon, letting time go to waste. "Why aren't you coming?" "Why would I? I can climb those stairs tomorrow, or later. Huneo's gonna bitch either way."
a1687c729c5d.t: Dengan sebahagian tenaganya kembali, Eori berdiri, menyediakan ucapannya, dan melepaskannya dalam satu nafas yang terpendam. “Terima kasih!” Dia berpaling ke arah tangga, dan dengan kerlingan pantas nampak Kibe terpaku di kerusinya, merenung ufuk, membiarkan masa terbuang. “Kenapa kau tak ikut?” “Kenapa nak ikut? Aku boleh daki tangga tu esok, atau nanti. Huneo akan merungut juga apa pun.”

a1dc4424080f.en: Harry is tense because of Takeo. July is being playful; Takeo doesn't give a shit. Harry goes to fetch beer, wondering whether they've found out who he truly is. He sets the beer on the table, and July grabs him by the shirt, slips him a note and winks.
a1dc4424080f.t: Harry tegang kerana Takeo. July bersikap nakal; Takeo tak peduli langsung. Harry pergi mengambil bir, tertanya-tanya sama ada mereka sudah tahu siapa dirinya yang sebenar. Dia meletakkan bir di atas meja, dan July menarik bajunya, menyelitkan sekeping nota dan mengenyit mata.

a284688491f1.en: Yosuke flicks open a knife, like the one Eori used to perforate Harry's neck. Harry jumps back, protecting his throat, his heart pounding as he breaks into a sweat. "If you don't cut that beard, I will." Dalila: "Did you just remember something?" Harry shakes his head. "I'm sorry, it's just that I—don't know. It felt weird."
a284688491f1.t: Yosuke membuka sebilah pisau, seperti yang digunakan Eori untuk menebuk leher Harry. Harry terlompat ke belakang, melindungi tekaknya, jantungnya berdegup kencang ketika dia mula berpeluh. “Kalau kau tak potong janggut tu, aku yang potong.” Dalila: “Kau baru teringat sesuatu ke?” Harry menggeleng. “Maaf, cuma aku—tak tahu. Terasa pelik.”

a9bfff691ed8.en: He walks the streets of Forway, thinking about everything he's gonna do with the sisters. The thought of stacking them on top of each other in bed and working them back and forth sends chills down his spine. His mind keeps compiling a list of things he wants to try with them, and wants them to teach him. He imagines Katsumi dressed as a teacher, teaching him all about how to please.
a9bfff691ed8.t: Dia berjalan di jalan-jalan Forway, memikirkan segala yang akan dibuatnya dengan dua beradik itu. Fikiran menindih mereka di atas satu sama lain di katil dan menghenjut mereka silih berganti membuat bulu romanya meremang. Fikirannya terus menyusun senarai perkara yang dia mahu cuba dengan mereka, dan mahu mereka ajarkan kepadanya. Dia membayangkan Katsumi berpakaian seperti guru, mengajarnya segala-galanya tentang cara memuaskan.

a9d1f2689214.en: Yosuke brings them inside and upstairs to show them the attic. They have a timehunk to bathe and get ready, hair tied up included. He explains their tight schedule; Rimir, the sub chef, lives in the top-right bunk bed.
a9d1f2689214.t: Yosuke membawa mereka masuk dan naik ke atas untuk menunjukkan loteng. Mereka ada satu timehunk untuk mandi dan bersiap, termasuk mengikat rambut. Dia menerangkan jadual mereka yang padat; Rimir, si sub chef, tinggal di katil dua tingkat sebelah kanan atas.

ac23579e3c9a.en: Yosuke sets the blade aside, grabs a Time Counter and sets it to a Quarter Time Chunk. "No excuses. Desmond, you're going to the barber." He gives directions and leaves: Harry has until Sunnihigh. Harry looks at Dalila, who points out the window. "Look at that intersection. See the sign? Follow it." She grabs her clothes and heads to the bathroom. Harry looks outside again. Here we go.
ac23579e3c9a.t: Yosuke meletakkan pisau ke tepi, mengambil sebuah Time Counter dan menetapkannya kepada Suku Time Chunk. “Tak ada alasan. Desmond, kau pergi ke tukang gunting.” Dia memberi arah dan beredar: Harry ada masa sehingga Sunnihigh. Harry memandang Dalila, yang menunjuk ke luar tingkap. “Tengok simpang tu. Nampak papan tanda? Ikut tu.” Dia mencapai pakaiannya dan menuju ke bilik air. Harry memandang ke luar lagi. Mari kita mulakan.

ac3e076a1ec4.en: Takeo lets out a big yawn, and the others follow suit. They chat about the world and random stuff.
ac3e076a1ec4.t: Takeo menguap besar, dan yang lain ikut sama. Mereka berbual tentang dunia dan benda-benda rawak.

accaf51998fe.en: Harry #14 and Dalila help Yosuke in the kitchen
accaf51998fe.t: Harry #14 dan Dalila membantu Yosuke di dapur

ad6166513902.en: Harry #13 and Severino, ready to cut down trees
ad6166513902.t: Harry #13 dan Severino, bersedia menebang pokok

ae247277072b.en: The guards talk about how cute the Saynas are: one is very playful, the other very quiet. Ryo says a friend of his is getting into breeding them, and he got first dibs.
ae247277072b.t: Para pengawal bercakap betapa comelnya Sayna itu: seekor sangat suka bermain, seekor lagi sangat pendiam. Ryo kata seorang kawannya sedang mula membiakkannya, dan dia dapat pilihan pertama.

af6ed0c09849.en: Harry nods and slides his plate over. She stabs her picker into the meat, and Harry feels a stab in his heart, as if it were his own flesh. Vitor gets pissed off and does the same, and now Dalila has a stack of Bagarisa to eat, which brings a slight smile to her face. Harry looks at her smile. I'm sorry.
af6ed0c09849.t: Harry mengangguk dan menolak pinggannya. Dalila menikam pickernya ke dalam daging, dan Harry rasa satu tikaman di hatinya, seolah-olah itu dagingnya sendiri. Vitor menjadi bengang dan buat yang sama, dan sekarang Dalila ada setimbun Bagarisa untuk dimakan, yang membawa senyuman kecil ke wajahnya. Harry memandang senyumannya. Maafkan aku.

b10431e80f69.en: The door opens and shuts just as loudly. Harry sits in bed, trying to place all these familiar faces and places; everything is hazy, because his vision is shit.
b10431e80f69.t: Pintu terbuka dan tertutup sama kuatnya. Harry duduk di katil, cuba mengecam semua muka dan tempat yang biasa ini; segalanya kabur, sebab penglihatannya teruk gila.

b228d3f345aa.en: The rustling hugs the inside of the wall, and moments later a dirty, bloodied Sayna appears: Katsumi. "So they got one of—" A second Sayna slowly comes out of the wall, as dirty as the first and wounded, but not as badly. They make their way to Ryo, and Katsumi starts screeching. Ryo laughs, picks up a Nari Refresher and gives it to the Saynas.
b228d3f345aa.t: Bunyi gemersik itu bergerak rapat di dalam dinding, dan beberapa saat kemudian seekor Sayna yang kotor dan berdarah muncul: Katsumi. “Jadi mereka dapat salah seorang—” Seekor lagi Sayna perlahan-lahan keluar dari dinding, sama kotornya dengan yang pertama dan cedera, tetapi tidak seteruk itu. Mereka menuju ke arah Ryo, dan Katsumi mula mencicit. Ryo ketawa, mengambil sebotol Nari Refresher dan memberikannya kepada Sayna-sayna itu.

b45953ace8ff.en: Eiri gets pissy, and Sora puts her foot down: she never signed a contract with Neferteri. They talk about how to find Arukia. Coema: "Make her want to contact us instead."
b45953ace8ff.t: Eiri menjadi merajuk, dan Sora bertegas: dia tidak pernah menandatangani kontrak dengan Neferteri. Mereka bercakap tentang cara mencari Arukia. Coema: “Buat dia yang nak hubungi kita.”

b5404b585eb3.en: July slowly falls back, pulling Harry on top of her. He feels in sync with her, and realizes he needs to take control, and be the one stroking, for once.
b5404b585eb3.t: July perlahan-lahan rebah ke belakang, menarik Harry ke atasnya. Harry rasa serentak dengannya, dan sedar dia perlu mengambil kawalan, dan menjadi yang menghentak, buat sekali ini.

b553522ceffd.en: He comes over. "Princess Eori. You have a lovely partner. Ready to order?" Eori feels a vein pop in her head; she swallows her pride in one big gulp, to avoid making a mess, and orders a feast. Kibe, not giving a shit, orders his own. The bartender gives them the total in Pearls and goes to get the juice.
b553522ceffd.t: Dia datang. “Puteri Eori. Pasangan tuan puteri sungguh menawan. Sedia untuk memesan?” Eori rasa satu urat timbul di kepalanya; dia menelan egonya dalam satu teguk besar, untuk mengelak membuat kekecohan, dan memesan satu jamuan. Kibe, tanpa peduli langsung, memesan hidangannya sendiri. Pelayan bar memberitahu jumlahnya dalam Pearl dan pergi mengambil jus.

b573ecdf0e01.en: Harry says he had no idea it took so long to trim all the branches. Severino: that's not even the most time-consuming part. Sculpting is.
b573ecdf0e01.t: Harry kata dia tidak tahu begitu lama masa diambil untuk memangkas semua dahan. Severino: itu bukan pun bahagian yang paling memakan masa. Mengukir yang paling lama.

b582fba90725.en: Harry at the hair salon, where white hair is in fashion right now, and cheap
b582fba90725.t: Harry di salun rambut, tempat rambut putih sedang menjadi fesyen sekarang, dan murah

b6591536a31d.en: Harry looks at the note while the two bartenders, Hanako and Mimi, poke fun at him
b6591536a31d.t: Harry memandang nota itu sementara dua pelayan bar, Hanako dan Mimi, mengusiknya

b73a4aae5a55.en: Ryo on the wagon heading back; Magi, alone, carries a green bag, looking tired and hungry
b73a4aae5a55.t: Ryo di atas gerabak dalam perjalanan pulang; Magi, seorang diri, membawa beg hijau, nampak penat dan lapar

b88f5536398c.en: I saved her, and she still won't say a word? Fine! Have it your way! The rebel Sayna turns and heads for the other corner of the room.
b88f5536398c.t: Aku selamatkan dia, dan dia masih tak nak cakap sepatah pun? Okey! Ikut suka kau! Sayna pemberontak itu berpaling dan menuju ke sudut lain bilik.

b8d261cf831c.en: The adventurer holds the Sayna up and looks it in the eyes. "My point is, you two are Red Winga property! You signed the contract, so now the Forway guards can come hunting you down!" Ryo: "Not for long. I have my connections." "Leave me out of it. The last thing I want is trouble at the embassy." "A promise is a promise. Our contract ends as soon as we set foot in Forway." "Is that a whole battalion of Forway guards?" "You'd better believe it…"
b8d261cf831c.t: Pengembara itu mengangkat Sayna dan memandang matanya. “Maksud aku, korang berdua harta Red Winga! Korang dah tandatangan kontrak, jadi sekarang pengawal Forway boleh datang memburu korang!” Ryo: “Tak lama lagi. Aku ada kenalan.” “Jangan libatkan aku. Benda terakhir yang aku nak ialah masalah di kedutaan.” “Janji tetap janji. Kontrak kita tamat sebaik kita jejak kaki di Forway.” “Itu satu batalion penuh pengawal Forway ke?” “Percayalah…”

b9afd244dc1d.en: Ryo holds them both in his arms, stroking the long hair with one hand and the short hair with the other. She resists his embrace, but he's stronger, and squeezes them in. "Let's talk this one out. Don't lie this time, or it'll be the last time." The sisters look at each other. Katsumi lets out a gasp. "Fine. I'll tell you what I did to the target."
b9afd244dc1d.t: Ryo memeluk kedua-duanya, mengusap rambut panjang dengan sebelah tangan dan rambut pendek dengan tangan yang lagi satu. Dia melawan pelukannya, tetapi Ryo lebih kuat, dan memeluk mereka erat. “Jom kita bincang. Jangan tipu kali ni, atau itu kali terakhir.” Dua beradik itu saling berpandangan. Katsumi mengeluh. “Okey. Aku beritahu apa aku buat pada sasaran tu.”

bc2b4899b4ab.en: He pulls them closer. "I've got something else that'll surprise you two. It spontaneously grows when you put it in your mouth." He chuckles loudly, with a lewd smile. Katsumi: "Can you show me?" She places her hands on his inner thighs and rubs against his taint. "I'll give you a private showing back at the hotel. Wanna see it too, Katsuki?" She gets flustered. "Dammit. She's so cute. I hope you two are having fun." They both smile back. Ryo: I need to bring them to Yosuke's restaurant before we go. Their stuff is legit.
bc2b4899b4ab.t: Dia menarik mereka lebih dekat. “Aku ada benda lain yang akan buat korang berdua terkejut. Ia membesar dengan sendiri bila korang masukkan dalam mulut.” Dia ketawa kuat, dengan senyuman miang. Katsumi: “Boleh tunjuk aku?” Dia meletakkan tangannya di peha dalam Ryo dan menggosok celah kangkangnya. “Aku bagi persembahan peribadi di hotel nanti. Nak tengok juga, Katsuki?” Katsuki menggelabah. “Celaka. Comel sangat dia. Aku harap korang berdua berseronok.” Kedua-duanya tersenyum kembali. Ryo: Aku kena bawa mereka ke restoran Yosuke sebelum kita pergi. Makanan dia memang power.

bcdf955e5342.en: Katsuki rejects the idea by hiding behind her sister. "Okay, making one of you famous. Katsumi, what do you do best?" A lewd smile. Katsumi, interested: "Sucking and fucking to get info?" "And who taught you how?" "The other ladies at the Red Winga?" "Indeed! A true art form. So! I've been thinking about building a whorehouse back home, with you two as the madams."
bcdf955e5342.t: Katsuki menolak idea itu dengan bersembunyi di belakang kakaknya. “Okey, buat salah seorang daripada korang terkenal. Katsumi, apa kau paling pandai?” Senyuman miang. Katsumi, berminat: “Hisap dan main untuk dapat maklumat?” “Dan siapa yang ajar kau?” “Wanita-wanita lain di Red Winga?” “Tepat sekali! Satu seni sebenar. Jadi! Aku dah fikir nak bina rumah pelacuran di kampung halaman, dengan korang berdua sebagai ibu ayam.”

bd76a543f65e.en: Coema lectures Eiri on her attitude; Sora defends Eiri; Coema knuckles both their heads
bd76a543f65e.t: Coema memarahi Eiri tentang sikapnya; Sora mempertahankan Eiri; Coema mengetuk kepala mereka berdua dengan buku lima

be1adbe6a07a.en: Then an idea pops into his head: what if she became a teacher to other girls, and they built a whorehouse? Ryo smiles lewdly as he feels his pocket growing bigger.
be1adbe6a07a.t: Kemudian satu idea muncul di kepalanya: bagaimana kalau Katsumi menjadi guru kepada gadis-gadis lain, dan mereka membina rumah pelacuran? Ryo tersenyum miang ketika merasakan poketnya semakin tebal.

be85ed3fde9b.en: Harry, in just his boxers, looks out the window at another Forway morning; Dalila, Hanako and Mimi are asleep
be85ed3fde9b.t: Harry, hanya berseluar boxer, memandang ke luar tingkap pada satu lagi pagi di Forway; Dalila, Hanako dan Mimi sedang tidur

bf26c6f536ef.en: He teaches them. Dalila goes to eat something, and the sub chef puts his hand over it. "We only eat after everyone else has had their fill." Dalila sulks.
bf26c6f536ef.t: Dia mengajar mereka. Dalila hendak makan sesuatu, dan sub chef meletakkan tangannya di atasnya. “Kita cuma makan selepas orang lain dah kenyang.” Dalila merajuk.

bff20eac9f25.en: Dalila and Harry on the wagon to Forway, Magi sitting next to Harry, holding her backpack and arrows
bff20eac9f25.t: Dalila dan Harry di atas gerabak ke Forway, Magi duduk di sebelah Harry, memegang beg galas dan anak panahnya

c24584e24668.en: Harry is about to take a spoonful when he realizes he's part of this conversation too, and looks at Nailah curiously. "I mentioned Desmond as well. It'll be a nice change of pace for both of you." Severino: "You did mention you've never been to Forway." Harry smiles. "Thanks!"
c24584e24668.t: Harry hendak menyuap sesudu apabila dia sedar dia juga sebahagian daripada perbualan ini, dan memandang Nailah dengan ingin tahu. “Aku sebut Desmond juga. Ia akan jadi perubahan suasana yang bagus untuk korang berdua.” Severino: “Kau ada sebut kau tak pernah ke Forway.” Harry tersenyum. “Terima kasih!”

c2c62835d772.en: Severino: "Let me guess. You wanted to ask why Dalila eats so much?" Vitor fiddles with his thumbs, silently agreeing. "She's from Broken-Tree. Didn't I already tell you the story of the three sisters?" "I know—but she's not cute anymore." Severino and Harry laugh out loud, and Vitor punches Harry in the stomach. "This is serious!" Severino: "I know plenty of Tolerideme boys—maybe even Gandew boys—who'd go crazy for her." Vitor looks down.
c2c62835d772.t: Severino: “Biar ayah teka. Kau nak tanya kenapa Dalila makan banyak sangat?” Vitor bermain-main dengan ibu jarinya, bersetuju dalam diam. “Dia dari Broken-Tree. Bukan ke ayah dah cerita kisah tiga beradik tu?” “Vitor tahu—tapi dia dah tak comel.” Severino dan Harry ketawa kuat, dan Vitor menumbuk perut Harry. “Ni serius!” Severino: “Ayah kenal ramai budak lelaki Tolerideme—mungkin budak lelaki Gandew juga—yang akan tergila-gilakan dia.” Vitor menunduk.

c37dc9851b0d.en: Eori paddles on as exhaustion sets in
c37dc9851b0d.t: Eori terus mendayung ketika keletihan mula datang

c44688e0a43d.en: Ryo: "First things first. Katsumi, apologize to Katsuki." "For what? Protecting us?" "For betraying your own family." Katsumi does. Ryo: "I've decided what we'll do with Harry, if he's still around. We'll protect him, and learn his secrets for ourselves. But first, we need to make you two famous."
c44688e0a43d.t: Ryo: “Perkara pertama dulu. Katsumi, minta maaf kepada Katsuki.” “Untuk apa? Lindungi kita?” “Kerana mengkhianati keluarga sendiri.” Katsumi berbuat begitu. Ryo: “Aku dah putuskan apa kita akan buat dengan Harry, kalau dia masih ada. Kita akan lindungi dia, dan pelajari rahsia dia untuk diri kita sendiri. Tapi pertama, kita perlu buat korang berdua terkenal.”

c5005192d633.en: Hanako: "All right! All right! Let's both go together!" Mimi: "But then you'll tell me to wash your back!" "But I wash yours too!" "Not fair! You have a big back! Tell Desmond to wash it!" She points at Desmond, just sitting there watching it all unfold. Hanako covers herself. "I don't want him touching me!"
c5005192d633.t: Hanako: “Okey! Okey! Jom pergi berdua!” Mimi: “Tapi nanti kau suruh aku gosok belakang kau!” “Tapi aku gosok belakang kau juga!” “Tak adil! Belakang kau besar! Suruh Desmond gosok!” Dia menunjuk Desmond, yang hanya duduk di situ memerhati semuanya berlaku. Hanako menutup dirinya. “Aku tak nak dia sentuh aku!”

c5b94f9ff865.en: Desmond smiles a little, but in his mind, the first dinner he can remember replays. Mimi flies over and lands on Harry's legs, her cold hands slapping his cheeks as she pulls his face close. Her worried little face brings out a smile. With curiosity: "Did Dalila's farts make you sick?"
c5b94f9ff865.t: Desmond tersenyum sedikit, tetapi dalam fikirannya, makan malam pertama yang boleh diingatnya berulang. Mimi terbang dan mendarat di kaki Harry, tangan sejuknya menampar pipinya sambil menarik mukanya dekat. Wajah kecilnya yang risau membawa senyuman. Dengan ingin tahu: “Kentut Dalila buat kau sakit ke?”

c7b7d256a04c.en: Eori's fists are ready to fly at the man coming back with their juices. She imagines all the incidents she could cause to vent her anger, but in the end she stays still. She sips her juice with her eyes closed, savoring the delicious fruity flavor, while Kibe sips his and gazes at the ceiling of clouds in the distance and the faraway lands below.
c7b7d256a04c.t: Penumbuk Eori sudah sedia hendak melayang ke arah lelaki yang kembali dengan jus mereka. Dia membayangkan semua insiden yang boleh dicetuskannya untuk melepaskan marah, tetapi akhirnya dia tetap diam. Dia menghirup jusnya dengan mata terpejam, menikmati rasa buah yang lazat, sementara Kibe menghirup jusnya dan merenung siling awan di kejauhan dan tanah jauh di bawah.

c815b9eb915e.en: The driver takes a longer route. Ryo picks up on it and bails. "That piece of shit works fast—maybe I should hire some Pussy Power."
c815b9eb915e.t: Pemandu mengambil laluan yang lebih panjang. Ryo perasan dan melompat keluar. “Taik tu kerja laju—mungkin aku patut upah Pussy Power.”

cb080128841e.en: "Oww, fucking disgusting!" Hanako wakes up and throws a Create Air spell at the window; Harry, laughing his ass off, sits down on his bed and enjoys the moment. Mimi, filtering the air through a cloth so far, looks at the clock shimmering in the sun's rays. "SUNNA!" She takes off for the bathroom, but Hanako catches her midway. "It's my turn this time!" "Lemme go! Lemme go!" Mimi kicks her tiny feet at Hanako's face.
cb080128841e.t: “Aduh, jijik celaka!” Hanako terjaga dan melempar jampi Create Air ke arah tingkap; Harry, ketawa terbahak-bahak, duduk di katilnya dan menikmati saat itu. Mimi, yang setakat ini menapis udara melalui kain, memandang jam yang berkilau dalam sinar matahari. “SUNNA!” Dia memecut ke bilik air, tetapi Hanako menangkapnya separuh jalan. “Giliran aku kali ni!” “Lepaskan! Lepaskan!” Mimi menendang-nendang kaki kecilnya ke muka Hanako.

cdc0c0333115.en: Eiri, Sora and other maids meet a big ship at the docks, along with many passengers
cdc0c0333115.t: Eiri, Sora dan pembantu rumah lain menyambut sebuah kapal besar di dermaga, bersama ramai penumpang

cde0aaabce1b.en: The sign: "Closed after Sunni to prepare for the Homeegg Tournament tomorrow. Come see it with us! - Yosuke". Ryo wanted them to taste the food here, but they can come back later. "Any other spots you want to visit before we go?" They say no.
cde0aaabce1b.t: Papan tanda: “Ditutup selepas Sunni untuk bersiap bagi Kejohanan Homeegg esok. Datang tonton bersama kami! - Yosuke”. Ryo mahu mereka merasa makanan di sini, tetapi mereka boleh datang semula nanti. “Ada tempat lain korang nak lawat sebelum kita pergi?” Mereka kata tidak.

ce283823c142.en: Morning: July talks with Takeo as he gets ready to head out
ce283823c142.t: Pagi: July bercakap dengan Takeo ketika dia bersiap untuk bertolak

ce4bc5445409.en: Harry looks over at the people around the next fires: some seem to be rejoicing, others stewing in their own thoughts. He turns to Severino as guilt churns his stomach. Dalila shuts down and starts to cry; the boy hugs her and looks at Harry with murder in his eyes. "I'm sorry?" Harry swallows his guilt. He doesn't know what happened, but it's all he can say.
ce4bc5445409.t: Harry memandang orang di sekeliling unggun api yang lain: ada yang nampak bergembira, yang lain tenggelam dalam fikiran sendiri. Dia berpaling kepada Severino ketika rasa bersalah memulas perutnya. Dalila menutup diri dan mula menangis; budak lelaki itu memeluknya dan memandang Harry dengan niat membunuh di matanya. “Maaf?” Harry menelan rasa bersalahnya. Dia tidak tahu apa yang berlaku, tetapi itu saja yang mampu dikatakannya.

cf8d49fe684d.en: Katsuki shakes her head. "Then what do you want?" She seems unsure. "Can you read, write and do math?" She looks interested. "Can you cook too?" She shakes her head. "Hmmm. Then I'll make you my assistant on my business trips. I'll teach you the basics of cooking and accounting. What do you say?" Katsuki hugs Ryo. "That's settled, then. Meanwhile, you'll become the biggest madam the world has ever seen!" He looks at Katsumi; her eyes sparkle with fierce strength, and lust. "That way, Harry will find us instead."
cf8d49fe684d.t: Katsuki menggeleng. “Habis kau nak apa?” Dia nampak tidak pasti. “Kau boleh membaca, menulis dan mengira?” Dia nampak berminat. “Boleh masak juga?” Dia menggeleng. “Hmmm. Kalau macam tu aku jadikan kau pembantu aku dalam lawatan perniagaan. Aku ajar kau asas memasak dan perakaunan. Macam mana?” Katsuki memeluk Ryo. “Selesai, kalau macam tu. Sementara itu, kau akan jadi ibu ayam terbesar yang dunia pernah lihat!” Dia memandang Katsumi; matanya bersinar dengan kekuatan garang, dan nafsu. “Dengan cara tu, Harry yang akan cari kita.”

cf9653a2dec0.en: They come across a broken wagon, broken armor and ragged clothes, with no discernible meat left. One of the men walks a little way into the forest and feels something watery hit his hand. He raises his fost lamp, and another droplet hits him right in the face: a dead girl lies in the tree branches.
cf9653a2dec0.t: Mereka terjumpa gerabak rosak, perisai pecah dan pakaian koyak-rabak, tanpa daging yang kelihatan. Salah seorang lelaki berjalan sedikit ke dalam hutan dan merasakan sesuatu yang berair mengenai tangannya. Dia mengangkat lampu fostnya, dan setitis lagi mengenai mukanya tepat: seorang gadis mati terbaring di dahan pokok.

d0bcd3a93f52.en: Harry: "I'm Desmond! Happy to serve you all today!" They start ordering. Yosuke's screams echo through the restaurant: "YOU'RE NOT TEST-TASTING, YOU'RE EATING IT!" Dalila, in the same tone: "I'M ENSURING QUALITY!" "YOU ATE A FIFTH OF THE SOUP ALREADY!" "IT TASTES REALLY GOOD!"
d0bcd3a93f52.t: Harry: “Saya Desmond! Gembira melayan semua hari ini!” Mereka mula memesan. Jeritan Yosuke bergema di seluruh restoran: “KAU BUKAN RASA, KAU MAKAN!” Dalila, dengan nada yang sama: “AKU PASTIKAN KUALITI!” “KAU DAH MAKAN SEPERLIMA SUP TU!” “SEDAP SANGAT!”

d153d0f57b72.en: Neferteri: "Huneo, who will oversee the punishment?" "Kibe." Kibe points at himself. "Why me? Just send a guard!" "I trust you to carry out the proper punishment, and to do the Cliff Walk with her." "She's the one on trial!" "And you've been lazier than I'd hoped, so I want this to help shape you both up."
d153d0f57b72.t: Neferteri: “Huneo, siapa yang akan mengawasi hukuman ini?” “Kibe.” Kibe menunjuk dirinya sendiri. “Kenapa aku? Hantar saja pengawal!” “Saya percaya tuan akan melaksanakan hukuman dengan betul, dan melakukan Cliff Walk bersamanya.” “Dia yang dibicarakan!” “Dan tuan lebih malas daripada yang saya harapkan, jadi saya mahu ini membantu membentuk kamu berdua.”

d175b6cd2600.en: Takeo lays out his Hifuna beast theory, and people sound scared. Harry wants to know more, but doesn't want the spotlight. Someone else asks the burning question: why would one come this far south? Takeo: "That's the real question. I'll present the evidence to the Forway guards and let them issue a quest for me, since none of you tasted weird." Many people shuffle their hands around, dreading the pain of losing their fingers again.
d175b6cd2600.t: Takeo membentangkan teori Hifuna beastnya, dan orang ramai kedengaran takut. Harry mahu tahu lebih, tetapi tidak mahu jadi tumpuan. Orang lain bertanyakan soalan yang membara: kenapa seekor sampai sejauh ini ke selatan? Takeo: “Itulah soalan sebenarnya. Aku akan bentangkan bukti kepada pengawal Forway dan biar mereka keluarkan misi untuk aku, sebab tak ada seorang pun daripada korang rasa pelik.” Ramai orang menggerak-gerakkan tangan, gerun dengan kesakitan kehilangan jari lagi.

d1c6e702b1f1.en: Kibe chills in the background while Eori paddles. Her emotions, on top of the exhaustion, start exploding inside her; tears come and she throws a fit. Kibe: "Shall I give you supper?"
d1c6e702b1f1.t: Kibe bersantai di belakang sementara Eori mendayung. Emosinya, ditambah keletihan, mula meletup dalam dirinya; air mata datang dan dia mengamuk. Kibe: “Nak aku bagi makan malam?”

d337093aa740.en: Harry watches the trees go by, then the people around him: all kinds share the wagon. I'm one of them now! He smiles at the passing trees, then his smile fades. I need to change my appearance before they find me.
d337093aa740.t: Harry memerhati pokok-pokok berlalu, kemudian orang di sekelilingnya: macam-macam jenis orang berkongsi gerabak itu. Aku salah seorang daripada mereka sekarang! Dia tersenyum kepada pokok yang berlalu, kemudian senyumannya pudar. Aku kena tukar rupa aku sebelum mereka jumpa aku.

d3589525e1ab.en: Dalila looks at Yosuke. "Do you know why he's so afraid of knives?" Yosuke: "WE'RE IN THE KITCHEN!—Those desserts, in a small timehunk! C'mon!" He claps. "YES, CHEF!" Dalila runs to the dessert station, where Rimir is working.
d3589525e1ab.t: Dalila memandang Yosuke. “Chef tahu kenapa dia takut sangat pada pisau?” Yosuke: “KITA DI DAPUR!—Pencuci mulut tu, dalam small timehunk! Cepat!” Dia bertepuk tangan. “BAIK, CHEF!” Dalila berlari ke stesen pencuci mulut, tempat Rimir bekerja.

d38c2095c8d2.en: Maicon leans in and lowers his voice. "A little Winga told me two whore sisters fled alongside a target. I can see them making a deal to bring the target back." Ryo: "Truly a lunatic plan. Who's the target?" Maicon laughs loudly. "Like they'd tell me that! They didn't even tell me what color the whores' hair is." Anger rises in Ryo. He drops a sack of balls on the table and stands. "Thanks for the info. I'm gonna go visit my lunatic friend." Maicon keeps eating.
d38c2095c8d2.t: Maicon membongkok dan merendahkan suara. “Seekor Winga kecil beritahu aku dua beradik pelacur lari bersama satu sasaran. Aku boleh nampak mereka buat perjanjian untuk bawa sasaran tu balik.” Ryo: “Memang rancangan gila. Siapa sasarannya?” Maicon ketawa kuat. “Macamlah mereka nak beritahu aku! Warna rambut pelacur tu pun mereka tak beritahu.” Kemarahan memuncak dalam diri Ryo. Dia menghempas sekarung bola di atas meja dan berdiri. “Terima kasih atas maklumat. Aku nak pergi melawat kawan gila aku.” Maicon terus makan.

d3ed68962779.en: The girl, Dalila, nods, and a boy sitting nearby squeezes between them and gives Harry a threatening look. Harry focuses back on his soup. "That's my son, Vitor," Severino says from across the fire. Harry looks at the son, then the father: aside from the age gap, they look nearly identical. He smiles nervously.
d3ed68962779.t: Gadis itu, Dalila, mengangguk, dan seorang budak lelaki yang duduk berdekatan menyelit di antara mereka dan memberi Harry pandangan mengugut. Harry kembali menumpukan perhatian pada supnya. “Itu anak aku, Vitor,” kata Severino dari seberang unggun api. Harry memandang si anak, kemudian si bapa: selain beza umur, mereka nampak hampir serupa. Dia tersenyum gugup.

d4618cc095fa.en: Harry sits up in bed, looking at the door; Takeo has steel pliers ready
d4618cc095fa.t: Harry duduk di katil, memandang pintu; Takeo sedia dengan playar keluli

d583d496720d.en: July: "You really don't know how to please women, do you?" Harry tenses up. "I—I guess not? What should I do?" July bites her tongue, leans in and gives him a quick kiss on the lips; their warm, humid breath mingles as she declares, blushing and serious: "I wanted an angry Bagarisa in my bed! Not a relaxed Wooly!"
d583d496720d.t: July: “Kau memang tak tahu cara puaskan perempuan, kan?” Harry menjadi tegang. “Aku—aku rasa tak? Apa patut aku buat?” July menggigit lidah, membongkok dan memberi ciuman pantas di bibirnya; nafas mereka yang hangat dan lembap bercampur ketika dia mengisytiharkan, tersipu dan serius: “Aku nak Bagarisa yang marah atas katil aku! Bukan Woolie yang santai!”

d5d7a2b1990b.en: "That's okay. You haven't touched the Bagarisa. Don't like the gaminess?" Harry puts on a fake smile and goes to cut it, but sees one of his Bagarisa friends being cut open. He sets down his fork as his stomach turns. "I'm sorry. I can't eat it." "That's okay. I can picture why."
d5d7a2b1990b.t: “Tak apa. Kau tak sentuh Bagarisa tu. Tak suka bau hamisnya?” Harry mengukir senyuman palsu dan hendak memotongnya, tetapi nampak salah seorang kawan Bagarisanya dibelah. Dia meletakkan garpunya ketika perutnya memulas. “Maaf. Aku tak boleh makan.” “Tak apa. Aku boleh bayangkan kenapa.”

d5dfcd622553.en: Chapter 1 - The past is the past.

d63c448628c5.en: Severino comes in and clears his throat. "Have you found the person?" Takeo: "No, but I found a purebred Naked Brunto." "What's that?" "Human? Yeah. One of you who never mixed blood with Darfaries or Wozefaries." "That's a thing?" "It's pretty rare. First time I've tasted one."
d63c448628c5.t: Severino masuk dan berdehem. “Dah jumpa orang tu?” Takeo: “Belum, tapi aku jumpa Naked Brunto baka tulen.” “Apa tu?” “Manusia? Ya. Salah seorang daripada kau yang tak pernah bercampur darah dengan Darfaries atau Wozefaries.” “Benda tu wujud?” “Agak jarang. Kali pertama aku rasa seorang.”

d743e3a11819.en: Harry asks how they make money from it. It depends: usually you sculpt everyday things and sell them every week or so at a market in a nearby, larger village, or, in his wife's case, some clients come to her directly, like Yosuke.
d743e3a11819.t: Harry bertanya bagaimana mereka mendapat duit daripadanya. Bergantung: biasanya kau ukir barang harian dan jual seminggu sekali atau lebih kurang di pasar di kampung besar berdekatan, atau, bagi isterinya, sesetengah pelanggan datang terus kepadanya, seperti Yosuke.

d86a0c7af0ba.en: Harry: "I hope I can at least match his skill." "No worries. He's still learning too." Harry enjoys this father-son kind of bonding.
d86a0c7af0ba.t: Harry: “Aku harap sekurang-kurangnya aku boleh setanding kemahiran dia.” “Jangan risau. Dia pun masih belajar.” Harry menikmati keakraban seperti bapa dan anak ini.

da35879976f8.en: Eori tortures Harry in his sleep

dacc8e469619.en: It's a magical show. Ryo hugs both sisters and looks at Katsumi, then Katsuki. Took a while, but I found it. Now I just need to figure out what the Red Winga is planning. It's clear as day they'll watch our every move, but are they still trying to find Harry? I know he's the result of Gabiro's last experiment, but is being able to use a Bagarisa interface that important? No. They've got to be trying to blackmail the Sanbi Kingdom, which means I can't contact Sanbi, directly or indirectly, or the Red Winga will cut my balls off. Protecting these two comes first and foremost.
dacc8e469619.t: Ia persembahan yang ajaib. Ryo memeluk kedua-dua beradik itu dan memandang Katsumi, kemudian Katsuki. Lama juga, tapi aku dah jumpa. Sekarang aku cuma perlu fikirkan apa yang Red Winga rancang. Jelas sekali mereka akan perhati setiap gerak-geri kita, tapi adakah mereka masih cuba cari Harry? Aku tahu dia hasil eksperimen terakhir Gabiro, tapi pentingkah sangat boleh guna antara muka Bagarisa? Tak. Mereka mesti cuba memeras ugut Kerajaan Sanbi, yang bermakna aku tak boleh hubungi Sanbi, secara langsung atau tidak, atau Red Winga akan potong bola aku. Melindungi dua orang ni yang paling utama.

db01dbe5ad31.en: For the first time, Dalila's eyes sparkle with life. She gulps down her food, her mood lifting a little. "Are you serious?" "Of course. He's one of our favorite clients." Nailah: "I'll ask {WIP-nailahMessenger} to carry a message to Yosuke before she sets off."
db01dbe5ad31.t: Buat pertama kalinya, mata Dalila bersinar dengan kehidupan. Dia menelan makanannya, moodnya terangkat sedikit. “Betul ke?” “Sudah tentu. Dia salah seorang pelanggan kegemaran kami.” Nailah: “Aku akan minta {WIP-nailahMessenger} bawa pesanan kepada Yosuke sebelum dia bertolak.”

db9f7c889cc7.en: July rests her head on his shoulder. "If you say so. Let's call it an impromptu date. Just make sure not to fall in love, since I might die soon." A sinking feeling slowly grows in Harry. "Why?" "I'm an adventurer, after all. I have a world to explore, and you alone can't satisfy me."
db9f7c889cc7.t: July melentokkan kepala di bahunya. “Kalau kau kata macam tu. Kita panggil ia temu janji mengejut. Cuma pastikan jangan jatuh cinta, sebab aku mungkin mati tak lama lagi.” Rasa tenggelam perlahan-lahan tumbuh dalam diri Harry. “Kenapa?” “Aku pengembara, lagipun. Aku ada dunia nak diteroka, dan kau seorang tak boleh puaskan aku.”

ded592db2a82.en: She sees Harry's face. She wants to see him again, she wants to dominate him again, but how can she, now that she no longer has her mother's protection?
ded592db2a82.t: Dia nampak wajah Harry. Dia mahu jumpa Harry lagi, dia mahu menguasainya lagi, tetapi bagaimana mungkin, sekarang dia tiada lagi perlindungan ibunya?

df03a6d9be5f.en: "Where are your parents? Don't you miss them?" "I don't have any," Harry says truthfully. "Then how were you born?" Harry remembers waking up in Sanbi Castle. "I have no idea—maybe I do have some, but I lost my memories of them—" Then he remembers how peaceful life in Rebula was. "—for all it matters, these past weeks felt like I was finally part of a family."
df03a6d9be5f.t: “Mana mak ayah kau? Kau tak rindu mereka?” “Aku tak ada,” kata Harry dengan jujur. “Habis macam mana kau lahir?” Harry teringat terjaga di Sanbi Castle. “Aku tak tahu—mungkin aku ada, tapi aku hilang ingatan tentang mereka—” Kemudian dia teringat betapa damainya hidup di Rebula. “—apa-apa pun, beberapa minggu lepas terasa macam akhirnya aku sebahagian daripada sebuah keluarga.”

dfa28411ed07.en: Dalila, with Nailah seated beside her, Severino, Vitor (timid, and really likes Dalila) and Takeo
dfa28411ed07.t: Dalila, dengan Nailah duduk di sebelahnya, Severino, Vitor (pemalu, dan sangat suka Dalila) dan Takeo

dfa8e413cf4a.en: She searches for books on the soul, but there's absolutely nothing, almost as if someone is hiding the information from the public. {WIP-eoriTeacher} appears and asks what she's after. Eori: "Soul, by Gabiro." The teacher, slightly flustered, leads her to a small, kind of dusty soul section at the very end. "Gabiro published many things, but never about the soul."
dfa8e413cf4a.t: Dia mencari buku tentang jiwa, tetapi langsung tiada apa-apa, hampir seolah-olah seseorang menyembunyikan maklumat itu daripada orang ramai. {WIP-eoriTeacher} muncul dan bertanya apa yang dicarinya. Eori: “Jiwa, oleh Gabiro.” Guru itu, sedikit menggelabah, membawanya ke bahagian jiwa yang kecil dan agak berhabuk di hujung sekali. “Gabiro menerbitkan banyak perkara, tetapi tidak pernah tentang jiwa.”

dfe8af9468dd.en: Forway is busy: people going places, doing things. Harry remembers what July said about opportunities out in the world. What am I even doing here? "You fall outta bed or something? Close the window!" Dalila covers herself with a blanket.
dfe8af9468dd.t: Forway sibuk: orang ke sana ke mari, membuat itu ini. Harry teringat apa July kata tentang peluang di luar sana. Apa sebenarnya aku buat di sini? “Kau jatuh katil ke apa? Tutup tingkap!” Dalila menyelubungi dirinya dengan selimut.

e00459c6e9f8.en: Kibe offers Eori food; she throws it aside. "Fine. Go hungry, then. Not like I care." Eori is sad, and angry, and the anger fuels her strength and determination: she'll conquer this and rise above Huneo. She starts thinking of ways to get rid of him, and falls asleep.
e00459c6e9f8.t: Kibe menawarkan makanan kepada Eori; dia mencampaknya ke tepi. “Okey. Laparlah kalau macam tu. Bukannya aku peduli.” Eori sedih, dan marah, dan kemarahan itu menyemarakkan kekuatan dan tekadnya: dia akan menakluk ini dan mengatasi Huneo. Dia mula memikirkan cara menyingkirkannya, dan tertidur.

e0d104c55858.en: Harry #13 and Severino head back, carrying wood
e0d104c55858.t: Harry #13 dan Severino pulang, membawa kayu

e1241a2187a7.en: Harry #13 sits by Dalila as a crowd gets ready to eat, everyone watching Takeo and Severino
e1241a2187a7.t: Harry #13 duduk di sebelah Dalila ketika orang ramai bersiap untuk makan, semua orang memerhati Takeo dan Severino

e2a8ce184323.en: She arrives by wagon and is welcomed by a teacher, {WIP-eoriTeacher}, who tells her a bit about the school.
e2a8ce184323.t: Dia tiba dengan gerabak dan disambut oleh seorang guru, {WIP-eoriTeacher}, yang menceritakan sedikit tentang sekolah itu.

e2d72d6b4a33.en: Dalila eats viciously; Harry and everyone else eat too
e2d72d6b4a33.t: Dalila makan dengan rakus; Harry dan semua orang lain makan juga

e3c6b6e8e786.en: A brief silence. A guard raises his hand, and the captain nods for him to speak. "Captain, could it be that we need more adventurers hunting by the Lukewarm Lake?" The captain carefully considers it. "Takeo? Any insights?"
e3c6b6e8e786.t: Senyap seketika. Seorang pengawal mengangkat tangan, dan kapten mengangguk menyuruhnya bercakap. “Kapten, mungkinkah kita perlukan lebih ramai pengembara memburu di tepi Lukewarm Lake?” Kapten menimbangnya dengan teliti. “Takeo? Ada pandangan?”

e4dcee958212.en: July looks him in the eyes. "So, how much is it going to cost?" Harry, mid-yawn: "What?" "Well, you know. I did say earlier I wanted to order you. Do you charge a flat rate per day, or per timehunk?" Harry tenses again. "I didn't—I wasn't expecting money."
e4dcee958212.t: July memandang matanya. “Jadi, berapa harganya?” Harry, sedang menguap: “Apa?” “Yalah, kau tahu. Aku ada cakap tadi aku nak tempah kau. Kau caj kadar tetap sehari, atau setiap timehunk?” Harry tegang lagi. “Aku tak—aku tak sangka ada duit.”

e52fecee532b.en: Takeo looks back at Harry. "Want to go first or last?" "La—last?" Takeo sets the pliers on {WIP-katsumiBandit}'s fingers. He clips them slowly, savoring the bones breaking, as the man screams in agony. He eats the finger, shakes his head, and spits the half-chewed finger back in the bandit's face.
e52fecee532b.t: Takeo memandang semula Harry. “Nak pergi dulu atau terakhir?” “Te—terakhir?” Takeo meletakkan playar pada jari {WIP-katsumiBandit}. Dia mengepitnya perlahan-lahan, menikmati tulang patah, ketika lelaki itu menjerit kesakitan. Dia makan jari itu, menggeleng, dan meludah jari yang separuh dikunyah kembali ke muka penyamun itu.

e6ef23712daa.en: Harry tries to break the ice. "Forway sure is big." Dalila ignores him. A bit flustered, he keeps going: "I didn't know we'd have to switch wagons to get to Forway, either." "The first wagon was going east, to {WIP-firstWagonStop}. The second one came north, to here." "You sure know a lot about roads."
e6ef23712daa.t: Harry cuba memecahkan kebekuan. “Forway memang besar.” Dalila tidak mengendahkannya. Sedikit menggelabah, dia meneruskan: “Aku pun tak tahu kita kena tukar gerabak untuk sampai ke Forway.” “Gerabak pertama pergi ke timur, ke {WIP-firstWagonStop}. Yang kedua datang ke utara, ke sini.” “Kau memang tahu banyak pasal jalan.”

e79a988262ba.en: Neferteri dangles the carrot: if Eori doesn't go, she'll throw out Harry's search quest. Eori has no choice but to concede, until a lightbulb goes off in her head: what if she can recreate Harry? Gabiro did it, so why can't she? Neferteri: I suspect she'll dive right into Soul research, just like Gabiro. I'll have to talk with the teachers and steer her away.
e79a988262ba.t: Neferteri menggantung lobak merah: jika Eori tidak pergi, dia akan membuang misi pencarian Harry. Eori tiada pilihan selain mengalah, sehingga satu idea terlintas di kepalanya: bagaimana kalau dia boleh mencipta semula Harry? Gabiro berjaya, jadi kenapa dia tidak boleh? Neferteri: Beta syak dia akan terus terjun ke dalam penyelidikan Jiwa, sama seperti Gabiro. Beta perlu bercakap dengan para guru dan mengalihkannya.

e847b72c7d11.en: Eori reads the books: people trying all kinds of shit, and all of it going wrong one way or another. The teacher: "I strongly advise picking another field as a career goal."
e847b72c7d11.t: Eori membaca buku-buku itu: orang mencuba macam-macam karut, dan semuanya gagal dalam satu cara atau lain. Guru itu: “Saya sangat menasihatkan kamu memilih bidang lain sebagai matlamat kerjaya.”

e8715f052e4a.en: Hanako, fighting with Mimi, points at Harry
e8715f052e4a.t: Hanako, bergaduh dengan Mimi, menunjuk ke arah Harry

e8a4c278dfb9.en: Chapter 4 - Anything is a contract away
e8a4c278dfb9.t: Bab 4 - Segalanya cuma sejauh satu kontrak

e9d7ab83ade9.en: He hears someone sneaking away and sees them try to escape through a window, but Takeo catches them, tortures them, and drags them into the forest, where distant screams can be heard.
e9d7ab83ade9.t: Dia mendengar seseorang menyelinap pergi dan nampak orang itu cuba lari melalui tingkap, tetapi Takeo menangkapnya, menyeksanya, dan mengheretnya ke dalam hutan, tempat jeritan jauh kedengaran.

ea4f0f0226fe.en: {WIP-katsumiBandit} (the bandit Katsumi killed in Book 7, Chapter 5, now revived): "Hey, do you know where we are?" {WIP-blackMaginaGuy}: "I have no fucking idea. I just woke up! The door is locked!" He looks around and moves closer. "{WIP-katsumiBandit}, we need to escape through the window!" His worried voice seeps into Harry's ears, waking him.
ea4f0f0226fe.t: {WIP-katsumiBandit} (penyamun yang dibunuh Katsumi dalam Buku 7, Bab 5, kini dihidupkan semula): “Hei, kau tahu kita di mana?” {WIP-blackMaginaGuy}: “Aku langsung tak tahu, celaka. Aku baru bangun! Pintu berkunci!” Dia melihat sekeliling dan bergerak lebih dekat. “{WIP-katsumiBandit}, kita kena lari ikut tingkap!” Suaranya yang risau meresap ke telinga Harry, membangunkannya.

ec20ab784e8c.en: Harry looks at the covered, now nearly obese Dalila. She moves her hand around, uncovers her buttocks from under the sheets, lets rip a massive, loud stinker, then quickly tucks her buttocks back in, keeping a pocket of warm air untouched by the vile fumes from a human's guts.
ec20ab784e8c.t: Harry memandang Dalila yang berselimut, kini hampir obes. Dia menggerak-gerakkan tangan, menyingkap punggungnya dari bawah cadar, melepaskan kentut busuk yang besar dan kuat, kemudian cepat-cepat menyelitkan punggungnya semula, mengekalkan satu poket udara hangat yang tidak tercemar oleh asap keji dari perut manusia.

ec54428c06ae.en: They end up cheering him on: Desmond has been feeling kind of down and regretful, so this will get his head in the game and let him whoop some ass. Harry isn't sure, but they convince him. Hanako gives him a few Pearls to buy a gift or something, and tells him to let loose, since he's been so tense for so long.
ec54428c06ae.t: Akhirnya mereka memberinya semangat: Desmond kebelakangan ini agak muram dan menyesal, jadi ini akan membuatnya fokus semula dan membolehkannya menunjukkan kehebatannya. Harry tidak pasti, tetapi mereka meyakinkannya. Hanako memberinya beberapa Pearl untuk membeli hadiah atau apa-apa, dan menyuruhnya bebaskan diri, kerana dia sudah begitu tegang begitu lama.

ed3a64ceaa84.en: {WIP-katsumiBandit} slaps his hands away. "You're lying! Touch me again and you'll meet the darkness." {WIP-blackMaginaGuy} grabs his shoulders again, tighter this time, leaning in and raising his voice. "Are you fucking with me? You're not throwing me under the Egua! You're not innocent either! You were the first one abusing them!"
ed3a64ceaa84.t: {WIP-katsumiBandit} menepis tangannya. “Kau tipu! Sentuh aku lagi dan kau akan jumpa kegelapan.” {WIP-blackMaginaGuy} mencekak bahunya lagi, lebih erat kali ini, membongkok dan meninggikan suara. “Kau main-mainkan aku ke? Kau takkan campak aku bawah Egua! Kau pun tak bersih! Kau yang pertama dera mereka!”

ee2895c8209c.en: "That's Dalila. She's in the same boat as you, so she'll be staying with us for a while, helping with the woodwork." "Nice to meet you. I'm Desmond," Harry says, with all the effort he can muster. "Nice to meet you too." Dalila's sad voice echoes over the fire; you can feel her broken heart oozing out of it.
ee2895c8209c.t: “Itu Dalila. Dia senasib dengan kau, jadi dia akan tinggal dengan kami buat sementara, membantu kerja kayu.” “Selamat berkenalan. Aku Desmond,” kata Harry, dengan segala usaha yang mampu dikerahkannya. “Selamat berkenalan juga.” Suara sedih Dalila bergema di atas api; kau boleh rasa hatinya yang hancur meleleh daripadanya.

ee307e124f88.en: Harry, smiling, takes a customer's order; Yosuke and the sub chef in the background, Dalila tasting something
ee307e124f88.t: Harry, tersenyum, mengambil pesanan pelanggan; Yosuke dan sub chef di belakang, Dalila merasa sesuatu

ef49caebab64.en: Coema is pissed that Eiri was so floppy in her will. "That's no daughter of mine! Why didn't you just open the gate and let him go?" Eiri is put on the spot: the thought never crossed her mind. Sora gets worried too. Sora defends Eiri, because she's Sora, but she gets knuckled too.
ef49caebab64.t: Coema bengang Eiri begitu lembik kemahuannya. “Itu bukan anak aku! Kenapa kau tak buka saja pintu pagar dan lepaskan dia?” Eiri tersepit: fikiran itu tidak pernah terlintas di fikirannya. Sora menjadi risau juga. Sora mempertahankan Eiri, kerana dia Sora, tetapi dia kena ketuk juga.

f061f52e2366.en: Harry #13-B sprawled on his seat next to Severino, Vitor sitting between them looking conflicted, on the way back with the wood
f061f52e2366.t: Harry #13-B terlentang di tempat duduknya di sebelah Severino, Vitor duduk di antara mereka nampak bercelaru, dalam perjalanan pulang bersama kayu

f0fa6b1901f5.en: The captain finishes the contract, grabs a Winga pen, pricks his finger and signs in blood. With a near-mechanical motion, he turns the contract around and lays down another Winga pen for Takeo. "You'll have one Sapphire to investigate the borders of the Hifuna region, and to lay out a plan to keep this from happening again."
f0fa6b1901f5.t: Kapten menghabiskan kontrak itu, mengambil pena Winga, mencucuk jarinya dan menandatangan dengan darah. Dengan gerakan hampir seperti mesin, dia memusingkan kontrak itu dan meletakkan pena Winga lain untuk Takeo. “Kau akan dapat satu Sapphire untuk menyiasat sempadan rantau Hifuna, dan membentangkan rancangan untuk mengelak perkara ini berulang.”

f203de98f962.en: Neferteri tries to intervene, but Itagiba rules it fair, specifically because Eori killed Huneo with nari gels. Neferteri shifts to removing Eori as an apprentice. Huneo doesn't quite get it, but says sure. Eori looks over at her mother: she must be cooking something up again.
f203de98f962.t: Neferteri cuba campur tangan, tetapi Itagiba memutuskan ia adil, khususnya kerana Eori membunuh Huneo dengan nari gel. Neferteri beralih kepada menyingkirkan Eori sebagai perantis. Huneo tidak begitu faham, tetapi kata boleh. Eori memandang ibunya: mesti dia sedang merancang sesuatu lagi.

f5cd750b0afc.en: Coema thanks the welcoming party, but tells them to get back to work, as if she were Eiri. Eiri: "I'm the King's maid, though!" "Then act like one. Now let's go home!"
f5cd750b0afc.t: Coema berterima kasih kepada rombongan penyambut, tetapi menyuruh mereka kembali bekerja, seolah-olah dia Eiri. Eiri: “Tapi aku King-maid!” “Kalau macam tu berkelakuanlah macam King-maid. Sekarang jom balik!”

f64a616525e3.en: Katsumi doesn't like that, and Ryo holds her back. "These two have had enough. You can hear everything from me. I'll sign it in blood." He tells them everything he knows. They ask the sisters where Arukia is; they have no idea. Emelia: "Good. Everybody wins here!"
f64a616525e3.t: Katsumi tidak suka itu, dan Ryo menahannya. “Dua orang ni dah cukup menderita. Kau boleh dengar semuanya daripada aku. Aku akan tandatangan dengan darah.” Dia memberitahu mereka semua yang dia tahu. Mereka bertanya dua beradik itu di mana Arukia; mereka tidak tahu langsung. Emelia: “Bagus. Semua orang menang di sini!”

f6760149a165.en: Eori and Kibe arrive at the base of Waterfall
f6760149a165.t: Eori dan Kibe tiba di kaki Waterfall

f688f7bb8c33.en: Severino: "Good job, you two. We got some fine wood today." Harry: "For sure. I'm beat." Vitor: "Can we keep this between us?" Severino and Harry listen closely. Vitor tries to say something, but the words just aren't there.
f688f7bb8c33.t: Severino: “Kerja bagus, korang berdua. Kita dapat kayu yang elok hari ni.” Harry: “Memang. Aku penat gila.” Vitor: “Boleh kita rahsiakan ni antara kita?” Severino dan Harry mendengar dengan teliti. Vitor cuba berkata sesuatu, tetapi perkataannya tiada.

f68c14b612be.en: Takeo snaps another finger off and starts eating in earnest. Harry screams as blood keeps pulsing from his hand. Like a couch potato devouring a bag of chips, Takeo can't stop snapping off one finger after another. By the fourth, Harry is losing strength, but he's still wide awake to the pain.
f68c14b612be.t: Takeo mematahkan satu lagi jari dan mula makan dengan bersungguh-sungguh. Harry menjerit ketika darah terus berdenyut keluar dari tangannya. Seperti kaki sofa melahap sebungkus kerepek, Takeo tidak dapat berhenti mematahkan jari demi jari. Pada jari keempat, Harry semakin hilang tenaga, tetapi dia masih segar bugar merasai kesakitan.

f6ccd91a4873.en: Ryo: "I know I said I'd pay, but do you really need to eat everything on the menu?" Maicon burps so loudly that some patrons look over in disgust, or impressed by such a feat; some laugh in the background. Mouth full: "It's a business opportunity. Now get more beer." "Sure. Sure." Ryo catches Harry's eye and circles a finger over the table; Harry gives a thumbs-up back.
f6ccd91a4873.t: Ryo: “Aku tahu aku kata aku belanja, tapi perlu ke kau makan semua dalam menu?” Maicon sendawa begitu kuat hingga sesetengah pelanggan menoleh dengan jijik, atau kagum dengan pencapaian itu; ada yang ketawa di belakang. Mulut penuh: “Ini peluang perniagaan. Sekarang ambil bir lagi.” “Ya la. Ya la.” Ryo menangkap mata Harry dan memusingkan jari di atas meja; Harry mengangkat ibu jari sebagai balasan.

f6d93809b3d8.en: On the final stretch to Waterfall, the currents pick up. Eori paddles and paddles, all for naught. Tears form as her arms give out against the current; she fights on with every last bit of her will, but she's losing ground.
f6d93809b3d8.t: Pada peringkat terakhir ke Waterfall, arus semakin kuat. Eori mendayung dan mendayung, semuanya sia-sia. Air mata terbentuk ketika lengannya menyerah melawan arus; dia terus melawan dengan setiap sisa tekadnya, tetapi dia semakin hanyut ke belakang.

f721098f67aa.en: July and Harry take a bath, relaxed and tired; Harry's head is tilted back, completely spent
f721098f67aa.t: July dan Harry mandi, santai dan penat; kepala Harry terdongak ke belakang, betul-betul kehabisan tenaga

f727cf25d4e6.en: Eori rushes him in pure rage; Kibe runs up the stairs, and Eori falls forward and bashes her forehead on a step. Kibe keeps climbing without giving a fuck. Eori takes a deep breath as her anger cools, then climbs after him.
f727cf25d4e6.t: Eori menerpanya dengan kemarahan tulen; Kibe berlari naik tangga, dan Eori jatuh ke depan dan menghentak dahinya pada anak tangga. Kibe terus mendaki tanpa peduli langsung. Eori menarik nafas dalam-dalam ketika kemarahannya reda, kemudian mendaki mengikutnya.

f7a825c3a4a1.en: Dalila grabs another piece of jerky and starts walking again, deep in thought. Harry follows her slower pace in silence. I'm sorry, but I can't let Eori find out I'm Harry. I'll try to make it up to you—but how?
f7a825c3a4a1.t: Dalila mengambil seketul lagi dendeng dan mula berjalan semula, tenggelam dalam fikiran. Harry mengikut langkahnya yang lebih perlahan dalam senyap. Maafkan aku, tapi aku tak boleh biar Eori tahu aku Harry. Aku akan cuba tebus—tapi macam mana?

f816ec9643fe.en: Author's to-do: after his soul splits, Harry loses the ability to understand anything in the Vraki language, and has to learn everything again from the beginning.
f816ec9643fe.t: Senarai tugas pengarang: selepas jiwanya terbelah, Harry hilang keupayaan memahami apa-apa dalam bahasa Vraki, dan perlu belajar segalanya semula dari awal.

f8d9353f41cf.en: Eori arrives at the Forway science school
f8d9353f41cf.t: Eori tiba di sekolah sains Forway

f991cb0d5baf.en: Severino nods, then looks back at Harry with anguish in his eyes. "Looks like you've been through a lot. I can tell. What's your name?" Harry goes through his memories and decides to fake it. "Desmond." "Desmond, do you have any family?" Harry shakes his head. "I—I don't remember anyone." "You're not the only one. If you stay and work with us, we'll give you a bed in the barn, and food." Harry nods. "Thank you."
f991cb0d5baf.t: Severino mengangguk, kemudian memandang semula Harry dengan derita di matanya. “Nampaknya kau dah lalui banyak benda. Aku boleh nampak. Siapa nama kau?” Harry menyelongkar ingatannya dan memutuskan untuk berpura-pura. “Desmond.” “Desmond, kau ada keluarga?” Harry menggeleng. “Aku—aku tak ingat sesiapa.” “Kau bukan seorang saja. Kalau kau tinggal dan kerja dengan kami, kami bagi kau katil di bangsal, dan makanan.” Harry mengangguk. “Terima kasih.”

f99b4ff9d8e8.en: Ryo and the sisters in a Forway hotel room
f99b4ff9d8e8.t: Ryo dan dua beradik itu di bilik hotel Forway

fa5f748b3415.en: Takeo confirms he has the Bagarisa, but he hasn't found the person people spoke of. He tells everyone to watch one another, and not to trust. Severino cuts in: they have a good grasp of the situation, so everyone should calm down. He explains that the other villages are coming to pick up their family and friends, and that anyone who lost their memories will get a hand, if they work their fair share. Takeo steps in: "Unless you're a filthy bandit." Harry's heart skips as Takeo locks eyes with him.
fa5f748b3415.t: Takeo mengesahkan dia ada Bagarisa itu, tetapi belum menjumpai orang yang disebut-sebut. Dia menyuruh semua orang memerhati satu sama lain, dan jangan percaya. Severino mencelah: mereka sudah faham keadaan dengan baik, jadi semua orang patut bertenang. Dia menerangkan bahawa kampung-kampung lain sedang datang mengambil keluarga dan kawan mereka, dan sesiapa yang hilang ingatan akan dibantu, jika mereka bekerja sepatutnya. Takeo mencelah: “Kecuali kau penyamun kotor.” Jantung Harry terhenti seketika ketika Takeo bertentang mata dengannya.

fb10e7c26c07.en: Eori's punishment begins at the Sanbi docks
fb10e7c26c07.t: Hukuman Eori bermula di dermaga Sanbi

fb5ce58c919a.en: Harry says he's never been there—oh, wait, he doesn't have any memories of being there. "Must be hard." Severino: "Not sure I can call you my friend, since we only met yesterday and all, but let's say you're a strong acquaintance." Harry smiles. "I like the sound of that!"
fb5ce58c919a.t: Harry kata dia tak pernah ke sana—oh, kejap, dia tiada ingatan pernah ke sana. “Mesti susah.” Severino: “Tak pasti aku boleh panggil kau kawan, sebab kita baru jumpa semalam, tapi katakanlah kau kenalan yang rapat.” Harry tersenyum. “Aku suka bunyinya!”

fc480b4ca18a.en: Yosuke's restaurant will be serving at the upcoming final Homeegg tournament! Tomorrow they'll be closed to the public so that it's all hands on deck preparing food for it. If they wow everyone at the tournament, he'll knock an Amethyst off the uniform payment.
fc480b4ca18a.t: Restoran Yosuke akan menghidangkan makanan di kejohanan akhir Homeegg yang akan datang! Esok mereka akan ditutup kepada orang ramai supaya semua orang dapat menyediakan makanan untuknya. Jika mereka memukau semua orang di kejohanan itu, dia akan menolak satu Amethyst daripada bayaran pakaian seragam.

fd45d83d9488.en: Severino finds Takeo sitting calmly on the bed, Harry against the wall in pain, and the two bandits passed out
fd45d83d9488.t: Severino mendapati Takeo duduk tenang di katil, Harry di dinding kesakitan, dan dua penyamun itu pengsan

ff12ba0b3316.en: July: "You sure you don't want to investigate Desmond?" Takeo puts something in the cart. "I already tasted his soul." July gives a girly laugh. "So what? I tasted him too." Takeo looks impatient. "I don't want to hear how your life got better as a girl."
ff12ba0b3316.t: July: “Kau pasti tak nak siasat Desmond?” Takeo meletakkan sesuatu ke dalam kereta. “Aku dah rasa jiwa dia.” July ketawa feminin. “Jadi apa? Aku pun dah rasa dia.” Takeo nampak tidak sabar. “Aku tak nak dengar macam mana hidup kau jadi lebih baik sebagai perempuan.”
